va.why: 'about eight million square metres' is 800万平方米. The draft's 80万 is off by a factor of ten.
'has banned fake grass from this year's event' means 禁止. 允许 reverses the meaning and contradicts the second clause of the same line.
The English says 11,282 signatures, so 12282 is a typo.
The draft leaves out 'the problems fake grass causes'. The proposal restores it accurately and reads grammatically.
In British English petrol is 汽油, which the ZH line also uses. 柴油 means diesel.
In 'need mowing', mowing is the gerund of the verb mow, so the POS should be v.
The draft has no 对……而言 frame, so the travellers read as the subject. The proposal fixes this, keeps in terms of / both…and / leisure / business, and avoids a second 而言.

In Chinese railway usage 快速列车 is a specific slow train class (K). These 'fast trains' run on the Rome–Milan high-speed network, so 高速列车 is correct. '3小时就能跑完' still renders 'can cover … in three hours'.
'同时依靠' keeps the sense of 'a combination of' and drops the stiff, word-for-word '三者结合来'.

Every element is kept: this is why, recent severe delays, caused by numerous works, chaos, holiday timing, matters for business, and tourism at 10% of GDP. The 的…的 chain and '在一个…的国家' are removed. The country in the English is clearly Italy, so naming it is safe.
'将能缩短…间距' renders 'will allow for a reduction of the distance' accurately and removes the stiff, long-separated '使……得以缩短'.
The time clause had no subject and attached to 我. Putting 你 inside it fixes this, and 'your favorite' stays implied.
'为什么要…' still implies 'we'. '尤其是+clause' keeps 'especially when…', and the wordy '在……的情况下' wrapper goes.
'忠于声誉' is a bad collocation. Splitting it into '忠于…独特的精神，不负它的声誉' is accurate, since 'true to reputation' means living up to it.
'不是偶然出现的' renders 'doesn't happen by accident'. The condition was already expressed with 才 and is now smooth, and the repeated 出现 and stiff 它 are gone.
Same meaning ('use their garden more'). '更多地使用' is more natural than the stiff '更常使用'.
'无论是本地人还是游客，都已…' carries 'alike' and 'have become' without the tacked-on '…都是如此'.
Minor: dropping one 的 removes the 的…的 chain and changes nothing in the meaning.

va.amended_proposed: 意大利国家铁路集团表示，运行受阻的部分原因是意大利陈旧的基础设施正在进行大规模改造。
va.why: The problem is real: '对…的大规模改善' is nominalised and the collocation is awkward. But the proposal's '在于，' puts a stray comma between the verb and its clause. Using 部分原因是…正在进行大规模改造 keeps 'huge improvements', 'obsolete' and 'partly' and reads cleanly.
The clause that follows explains why capacity is short. A colon marks that relation, and it is valid here because the colon's scope runs to the full stop with no later semicolon.
'常客' is the sense for people and does not fit delays in media coverage. '固定存在的事物；常见内容' matches the sense used here.
'同一时刻' is only how this line's translation handles the phrase in context, not what the phrase means. 'at any given time' = 在任一时刻/在任何特定时刻.

vb.why: k54: eight million square metres is 800万平方米. 80万 is a factual error.
k54: 'has banned' means 禁止. 允许 reverses the meaning and contradicts the second clause.
k54: EN says 11,282, so 12282 is a wrong figure.
k54: the draft leaves out 'the problems … causes'. The proposal restores it, keeps the 提高对……的认识 frame that matches the raise-awareness gloss, and stays grammatical.
k54: petrol is 汽油, and the ZH line already says 汽油. 柴油 means diesel.
k54: the headword mow is a verb ('need mowing' is a gerund of mow). The n. label is wrong.

k07: the draft has a broken topic structure in which the travellers read as the subject. 无论对……还是……而言 is correct and idiomatic, and 从……来看 avoids repeating 而言 while still matching the in-terms-of gloss.

vb.amended_proposed: 高速列车可在3小时内跑完两座城市之间500公里的路程。
vb.why: k07: 快速列车 is a specific slower train class in Chinese usage, so changing it to 高速列车 is right. The amendment keeps the neutral 可在3小时内, because 3小时就能 adds an 'only' emphasis that the EN does not have.
k08: 三者结合来支付 is a stiff calque. 同时依靠 conveys 'a combination of' naturally and matches the summary.
k07: it fixes the 的…的 pile-up and the awkward 在一个……的国家 frame. 意大利 is the referent, so making it explicit is faithful; 关系重大 collocates better; the flowing clause structure preserves the meaning.
k07: 使……得以缩短, with more than 20 characters between 使 and 缩短, is translationese. 将能缩短 keeps the 'allow for' meaning and the modality.

vb.amended_proposed: 今年夏天，在你享受最喜欢的街区街头节庆时，我希望你能记住，这样的节庆之所以存在，是因为有社区的支持。
vb.why: k08: the dangling time adverbial is a real problem. The cleaner fix is 在你享受……时, which avoids the sentence opening with 你 as subject and then switching to 我.
k08: the redundant second 我们 and the wrapping 在……的情况下 are translationese. 尤其是 followed by a clause is idiomatic and keeps the 'especially when' meaning.
k08: 忠于声誉 is a collocation error. Splitting into 忠于……精神，不负它的声誉 is precise for 'true to … reputation', and 它 clearly refers to 威克公园.
k08: removes the repeated 出现 and the translationese pronoun 它. The draft already has a 才 condition, so 只有……才 does not overstate it, and the meaning is preserved.
k54: 更多地使用 covers the ambiguous 'more' (more often or more extensively) more faithfully than 更常, which limits it to frequency, and it reads more naturally. A minor but real improvement.
k07: the tacked-on 本地人和游客都是如此 copies English word order. 无论……还是……都 builds 'alike' into the sentence, with no change in meaning, and matches the summary.
k07: 将带来的最重要的变化之一 is standard, natural Chinese, and the two 的 are not adjacent. Dropping one is mere taste and moves away from the 最……的……之一 pattern given in the 'one of the most' gloss.

vb.amended_proposed: 意大利国家铁路集团表示，运行受阻的部分原因在于意大利正在对陈旧的基础设施进行大规模改造。
vb.why: k07: 大规模改善 is an awkward collocation, and 改造 is right. The amendment drops the unnatural comma after 在于 and keeps 对 (improvements in) and 大规模 (huge), so the line still matches the glosses.

k07 summary: what follows explains the capacity problem, so a colon is clearer than a comma splice. The colon sits in the last clause and runs to the end of the sentence, which follows Chinese punctuation norms.
k07: the gloss should give the sense used in this sentence, a regular, established feature of media coverage. 常客 as a dictionary sense refers to a person and is misleading here.
k07: 同一时刻 is the contextual rendering, not the meaning of the phrase, and （给定） is a calque. 在任一时刻；在任何特定时刻 is the correct dictionary sense, and the ZH line can still say 同一时刻 in context.

findings.current: 皇家莎士比亚剧团本周发布的这项“该表演了”（Time to Act）研究还发现，对照组学生依赖棕榈树之类的“荒岛俗套”，而目标组学生则“写得更舒展，［呈现出］一幅关于天空、大海和大气状况的更广阔图景”。
findings.proposed: 皇家莎士比亚剧团本周发布的这项“该表演了”（Time to Act）研究还发现，对照组学生依赖棕榈树之类的“荒岛俗套”，而目标组学生则“写得更开阔，［呈现出］天空、大海和天气状况更为全面的图景”。
findings.reason: Here “expansive” means wide-ranging in scope, which the next phrase (“a broader picture”) confirms. 舒展 suggests a relaxed or flowing style, which is a different idea. In a child's description of a desert island, “atmospheric conditions” means the weather, so 大气状况 is stiff and too literal. “一幅关于……的更广阔图景” is translationese.

findings.reason: [1] has already introduced the study as “一项开创性研究”. When [3] starts again with “一项研究”, a Chinese reader takes it as a second, different study. va.why: The current text matches the file. Words are "classed as" more sophisticated or rarer, so 被归为 is clearer. 生僻 is the exact Chinese sense of "rare" when it describes words. The meaning is unchanged.

va.why: "Landed a punch" means the punch hit home. 在学术上一击命中 has no object and reads oddly. 打出了漂亮的一拳 keeps the boxing image and the idea of success, and it reads naturally.
"Unrelenting" means never easing. 有增无减 adds "keeps increasing", which the English does not say. 永无止境的渴求 is accurate and natural.
The current gloss 有增无减 adds a growth sense that "unrelenting" does not have. 无休止的；持续不断的 is correct.

Every clause is still there: the RSC commissioned the study, and O'Hanlon is from the RSC. Splitting the long attributive chain removes the stacked 的. The parallel 方式…方式 is cleaner. It is clearly more natural.
"Rarer" describes words, so 生僻的 is the exact sense. It also stays consistent with index 0.
The relative clause ("which was combined with") keeps its meaning, and so does 结合. The double 而 and the literal 而这一点又与…结合在一起 are gone. It is clearly more natural.
This removes the stiff stacked 尝试凭借 and fixes the 流程/过程 inconsistency. "Trying to imagine your way through" is still rendered precisely.
有助于 is the standard written form. It is a harmless one-character change and the meaning is the same.
The current wording can be misread as "芬兰实现了负碳排放", a subject-predicate clause. 位于芬兰、实现了负碳排放的 matches the EN: LUMI is in Finland and LUMI itself is carbon-negative.
为了解世界 risks being read as 为了/解. 为认识世界而必须付出的代价 is unambiguous and exact.
The second 她 right after the colon is redundant, and dropping the subject reads more naturally. The meaning is unchanged.
作为对…的礼赞 is a nominalised calque. 这一礼赞人类创造才能的奖项 keeps the same content (the prize celebrates ingenuity and is entering its 20th year) and reads better.
This fixes the clunky 用于…使用. The power/intelligence wordplay and the sense of "techniques to use power more intelligently" are kept.
In "suggested that…", O'Hanlon is putting forward a view. 暗示 (to imply indirectly) is the wrong sense. 提出（看法）；表示 is correct.
"Feel paralysed in the face of daunting problems" is figurative: unable to act. The literal 瘫痪的 is not the sense used here. The new gloss still matches 不知所措 in the ZH.
This "while" is contrastive (control pupils vs target children). Learners often misread it as 当…时, and it is a key 考研 point. The entry conj. 而；然而（表对比） is correct for this sentence.
The contrastive "while" carries the main contrast of the sentence, and the ZH renders it as 而. The entry is correct and should be memorised.
[3] refers to the same study as [1], and [4] and [5] call it 这项. A second 一项研究 misleads readers into thinking it is a different study. 这项 is accurate to the referent.
In ZH, 这段文字 can only point back to the 瓶中信, which is wrong. "The passage" is the extract from The Tempest the task is based on, so 相应的剧本选段 is accurate.

vb.why: k09: Without 被, “归为更高级或更罕见的词语” reads as if the words are doing the classing. 被归为 fixes that. 生僻 is the standard Chinese word for rare vocabulary. The meaning is unchanged.

k09: Here “expansive” means wide-ranging, so 开阔 fits better than 舒展. In a description of a shipwreck scene, “atmospheric conditions” means the weather, so 天气状况 is right and 大气状况 is too technical. “一幅关于……的” is translationese. Follow-up: the gloss for “broad” (宽广的；广阔的) should add 全面的 to match the new ZH.
k09: This gives the sense actually used here (wide in scope or content) and matches the revised ZH. 舒展的 did not give that sense.

k09: 一击命中 adds “on the first strike” and is an odd fit with 在学术上. 打出了漂亮的一拳 keeps the boxing image and means scoring a successful hit. Follow-up: change the land a punch gloss “（喻）一击命中” to match, e.g. “（喻）得分；占上风”.
k10: unrelenting means never letting up, not increasing. 有增无减 adds a growth idea the English does not state. 永无止境 is accurate and natural.
k10: The gloss should not include growth (有增无减). 无休止的；持续不断的 is the exact sense and matches the revised ZH.

k09: The long pre-modifier with two 的 in a row before the name is a real translationese pattern. Splitting it into two clauses reads better and keeps every fact. The parallel “……的方式……的方式” mirrors “the way… how”.
k09: For words, 生僻的 is the precise Chinese sense, and it matches the revised ZH in index 0.
k09: The sentence uses 而 twice, and “而这一点又与……结合在一起” is a stiff word-for-word rendering of the relative clause. “与之相结合的，是……” keeps the meaning and reads naturally.
k09: “习惯了尝试凭借想象” stacks 尝试 and 凭借 and reads stiffly. 设法凭想象 is smoother, matches the gloss for imagine one's way through, and keeps 流程 consistent. The meaning is unchanged.
k09: The standard form is 有助于 + object. Bare 有助 + object is headline shorthand and is not the normative form for a title learners will read. It costs only one character.
k10: “芬兰实现了负碳排放的超级计算机” can genuinely be misread as a subject-predicate clause (Finland achieved…). “位于芬兰、实现了负碳排放的” removes that reading.
k10: “为了解世界” invites the misparse 为了/解世界. 认识世界 is a natural, precise collocation for understanding the world, and the change removes the hiccup without altering the meaning.
k10: Restating 她 after a colon is normal, natural Chinese, and the current text is accurate. Dropping it is purely a matter of taste.
k10: “作为对……的礼赞” is a nominalised, translationese structure. “这一礼赞人类创造才能的奖项” is tighter, uses 礼赞 correctly as a verb, and loses no meaning.
k10: “用于更智能地使用电力” repeats 用 and is clunky. “不仅能让我们……还能……” is natural and keeps both the purpose and the play on power and intelligence.
k09: Here “suggested that…” means she put forward a view, so 暗示 (to imply) is the wrong sense and misleads learners. The new gloss still contains 表示, which matches the ZH.

vb.why: k10: The proposal is right to drop the literal 瘫痪的. But 束手无策 means having no solution, which is not the same as being unable to act. Keeping 不知所措 first also matches the ZH.

k09: Contrastive while (而) is a key reading point that 考研 learners often misread as 当……时, and the ZH uses 而 here. It has to be annotated. 然而 also appears in standard learner dictionaries for this sense.
k09: Contrastive while carries the main contrast of this sentence, and the ZH uses 而. The passage repeats annotations for other words (study, research), so annotating it again is consistent.
k09: After “一项开创性研究” in [1], a second 一项研究 reads in Chinese as a different study. 这项 keeps the reference chain correct, and the referent is the same.

findings.current: 事先索要小费的情况正变得越来越普遍。

findings.reason: “正变得越来越……”是 is becoming 的典型翻译腔，“越来越……了”已经表达出进行中的变化，更地道。

findings.current: 这种上涨有时被称为“小费通胀”，即对小费数额越来越高的预期。

findings.current: 值得注意的是，从小费中获益的主要是这些从业者中的一部分人，比如服务员，而不是另一部分人，比如厨师和洗碗工。
findings.proposed: 值得注意的是，从小费中获益的主要是这些从业者中的一部分人，比如服务员；另一部分人，比如厨师和洗碗工，则无法从中获益。
findings.reason: “……主要是A，比如X，而不是B，比如Y”套用了英文 but not others 的结构，两个“比如”插入语夹在中间，句子拖沓、不顺。改成对照句“另一部分人……则无法从中获益”，意思完全相同。

findings.current: 为了确保所有员工都能拿到公平的工资，一些餐馆禁止给小费，同时提高了价格，但这场向免小费服务转变的运动基本上已经不了了之。

findings.reason: “向免小费服务转变的运动”是 movement towards 的直译，改成“转向免小费服务的运动”更紧凑；前一分句“禁止……，同时提高了……”体貌不一致，改成“禁止给小费并提高了价格”更顺。

findings.current: 而且，正如我们的研究所强调的，如今付小费似乎更具强制性，更少出于慷慨，并且常常与服务质量完全脱节。

findings.reason: “更少出于慷慨”是“更少＋动词短语”的欧化结构，读来别扭；“慷慨的成分更少”准确表达 less generous，和“更具强制性”对得上。

findings.current: v. 保留；仍然在
findings.proposed: v. 留在；仍处于

findings.current: entitled
findings.proposed: entitle
findings.reason: “a programme entitled ‘X’”是动词 entitle（给……题名）的过去分词，作被动的后置定语，本质上还是动词；同句的 supported 也是这样处理的（标作 support v.）。词典里的形容词 entitled 是另一个意思：“有资格的；自以为有权享受的”。所以按 adj. 列出会误导。

findings.current: adj. 名为……的；题为……的
findings.proposed: v. 给（书、作品等）题名（此处过去分词作后置定语：题为……的）
findings.reason: 词性和意思应与动词 entitle 的题名义一致；不能写成形容词，因为形容词 entitled 的意思是“有资格的”。

findings.current: be…better at
findings.proposed: be good at
findings.reason: 词头应该用词典原形 be good at，句中的 better 是比较级。释义相应改为“擅长；在……方面做得好（句中为比较级 be much better at：在……方面做得好得多）”。

It also stuffs a long parenthetical into the summary, then calls the listed 办法 "目标" ("其中任何一项目标"), so the terms clash. Fixed via #14 instead.
k14 [18]: "services that create health" means services that produce or improve health. "促进健康的服务" is just as precise and clearly more natural than "能带来健康的服务".
k13 [6]: "付费时机" can be read as the time you pay the bill. "That timing" means the time the tip is paid (after the service). "在这个时机付小费" is precise, and every clause is kept.
k13 [11]: the menus are suggested tip options. "what they owe" is the bill amount. Adding "小费" makes clear what is well above 20%, and "账单金额" is precise and more natural.
k14 title: before a verb phrase meaning "must urgently", the standard editorial form is "亟须". "亟需" is used before nouns.
k13 [18]: "正经不住" invites a misreading as "正经". "越来越多的" already carries the ongoing trend, so the meaning is unchanged. It also matches the summary.
k13 [14]: "拿小费员工的最低工资" is a stiff noun pile-up with a missing 的. "领取小费的员工，最低工资可以低至…" is just as precise (tipped minimum wage = the minimum wage of tipped staff) and matches the gloss.
k13 [7]: "越来越普遍了" fully renders "is becoming more common" without the "正变得" translationese.

k13 [13]: "对小费数额越来越高的预期" naturally parses as an expectation that tips keep rising. That is a faithful noun-phrase rendering of a noun-phrase definition, and the two possible readings come to the same thing. The proposed subjectless "预期小费数额会越来越高" adds a forecasting "会". It drifts from the normative sense of "expectation" (what is expected of customers) and is not clearly better.

k13 [16]: "tipping primarily benefits some... but not others". The contrast "另一部分人…则无法从中获益" keeps "主要", both examples and the negation for the others. It reads far more naturally than the "而不是另一部分人，比如…" calque.
k13 [17]: "禁止给小费并提高了价格" and "转向免小费服务的运动" keep every element (banned tipping, increased prices, movement towards) and are more compact and natural.
k13 [20]: "less generous" = tipping involves less generosity. "慷慨的成分更少" is precise, and it avoids the Europeanised "更少出于慷慨".
k13 summary: "更少出于慷慨" matches the file. This syncs it with the sentence 20 fix (#12).

va.amended_proposed: 英国在落实这些办法上都未能取得实质性进展
va.why: k14 summary: right that "这些目标…取得进展" has a subject–predicate mismatch and no referent (the summary only mentions 办法). But "这些方面" is vague, and the clause still has no subject. The aims are exactly the 办法 just mentioned, so "在落实这些办法上" is precise. "英国" matches the subject used earlier in the summary. Choose this over #1.
k14 [10]: "没能在其中任何一个目标上取得实质性进展" keeps "these aims" (via 其中…目标) and the total negation of "any". It is much less clunky than the nested "在这些目标中的任何一项上".
k14 [4]: "越来越难以获得" fully renders "is becoming increasingly inaccessible". "正变得" is translationese.
k14 summary: "cancer and infant mortality rates" means two mortality rates. "癌症和婴儿死亡率" leaves "癌症" looking like a separate metric. The fix matches the body text of [3].

k14 [18]: "remain" is intransitive here (stay or continue to be at the centre). "保留" is the sense of "retain" (which this passage uses in [12]), so it invites confusion. "留在；仍处于" is the correct sense.

k14 [11]: "a programme entitled X" is the past participle of the verb entitle (to give a title), used as a postmodifier, just like "supported" → support v. here. Learner dictionaries (e.g. Oxford) give adj. "entitled" the sense "feeling one has a right", so the adj. label misleads.
k14 [11]: goes with #19. "v. 给（书、作品等）题名" is the correct sense, and the note "过去分词作后置定语：题为……的" gives the in-context meaning.

k14 [7]: the dictionary-form headword is "be good at" (better is its comparative). The highlight "be … better at" is fine as the inflected form. The gloss must be updated at the same time, as the proposal states (擅长；在……方面做得好; in this sentence the comparative: 做得好得多). Otherwise headword and gloss won't match.

k14 [5]: in "As demand for healthcare continues to grow", as is a conjunction meaning "随着". It is a high-frequency 考研 point, and k13 [20] already annotates as "正如". "as conj. 随着" is correct for this sentence.
k13 [2]: "iPad" is a brand name, not vocabulary to memorise. The entry matches the file, and the sentence keeps plenty of other entries.

k13 [15]: "low-wage service workers" is what [16] refers back to as "these workers" (译作"这些从业者"). "服务业从业者" keeps the reference consistent with [14] and [16]. It also covers cooks and dishwashers, which "服务人员" does not.

vb.why: k14 s16: "国家肥胖战略" is a word-for-word rendering and reads as if the strategy promotes obesity. "肥胖症防治战略" is the standard Chinese term, the meaning is unchanged, and it still matches the gloss obesity = 肥胖（症）.

k14 summary: this edits the same span as #14, so both cannot apply. Its bracketed list makes the summary heavy, and it still calls the listed 办法 "目标", so the mismatch stays. #14 (amended) fixes the real error with a minimal change.
k14 s18: "能带来健康的服务" is translationese. "促进健康的服务" is the idiomatic public-health wording for services that create health, and the meaning is unchanged.
k13 s6: "付费时机" can be read as the time of paying the bill rather than tipping. "在这个时机付小费" is precise, and it keeps 时机, so the timing gloss still maps.

k14 title: before a verb phrase (重新思考), the standard form is "亟须" (must urgently); "亟需" means "urgently need" and takes a noun. This is a standard copy-editing fix with no change in meaning.
k13 s18: "正经不住" can be misparsed as 正经/不住. "越来越多的" already carries the ongoing sense, and the summary already says "经不住".
k13 s14: "拿小费员工的最低工资" is a clunky noun pile-up with no 的. "领取小费的员工，最低工资……" reads naturally and matches the gloss "（领取小费员工的）".

va.why: The current text matches the file. 'The idea that one might…' points to something people really did (s7–8). '有人可能会……这一想法' is translationese and reads like a plan someone had. '竟会有人……这一点' is precise and natural, and it keeps the incredulous tone.

va.amended_proposed: 我痴迷于这些物品的一个特定方面——它们的价格，对此我并不觉得有什么可抱歉的。
va.why: The problem is real: '对此我毫无歉意' is word-for-word. But '毫不讳言' means 'make no secret of / speak frankly', which is a different sense. 'make no apology for' means the author sees nothing to apologise for, and s16 'I am an economist, after all' justifies that. '并不觉得有什么可抱歉的' is exact and idiomatic. The dash restructure is kept.

Every element is kept: 后来的文明, skilled blacksmith's labour in a nail → 钉子中凝结的熟练铁匠的劳动, 'even more than the raw material' → 甚至胜过看重原材料. It is clearly more natural than the current text, which puts the comparison first.
In context, 'over the years' covers centuries (Roman times, 1695). '这些年来' suggests recent years. '随着时间的推移' is accurate and natural.
'I've learnt from writing two books' refers to books already written. '写两本……的书，让我学到了一点' is awkward. '在写两本发明史著作的过程中，我认识到一点' is precise, and '认识到' matches the learn gloss.
'转手' suggests passing on goods or reselling, which is wrong in register for babies. '在照料者之间换手' says exactly what 'passed between caregivers' means.

va.amended_proposed: v. 传递；（从一人手中）递给（另一人）
va.why: '转手' is the wrong sense, so the problem is real. But '传来传去' describes the whole 'passed between' pattern, not the meaning of the verb pass, and it implies back-and-forth. The gloss should give the verb's sense: handing something from one person to another.

'where pupils are asked to sit still' modifies 'instructive teaching'. The proposal makes it a modifier, so the subject of '可能是……原因之一' is unambiguous. '通过观察和模仿来学习' is more idiomatic. All clauses are kept.

'受铁和能源降价的推动' renders 'driven partly by cheaper iron and cheaper energy' exactly, without the clumsy clause-as-agent passive. Dropping the doubled 的 improves the flow. 'partly' and 'simply' are both kept.
'想设法' renders attempt twice and is awkward. '试图' renders 'an attempt to' precisely.
'以致' normally introduces an undesirable result. A result of degree after '如此之深' calls for '以至于'. The meaning is unchanged.
This keeps the gloss consistent with index 10. 'so…that' = 如此……以至于 is the standard degree-result gloss.

The current text matches the summary. The long front-loaded modifier and the comma splice make it hard to read. The proposal is accurate ('most of the credit goes to nail manufacturers who simply found more efficient ways…') and natural.
'更加满足的孩子' is unidiomatic as an attributive. '更有满足感的孩子' renders 'more contented children' precisely and naturally.
This makes the summary consistent with index 13. The current text matches the summary.
Dashes mark the explanatory insertion between subject and predicate clearly. The meaning of 'in which infants are carried in slings' is fully kept, and the sentence reads better.
'这样骤然转向……很可能是有害的' keeps 'This abrupt shift to…' and 'was likely to have been harmful'. It removes the nominalised 向……的转变 and the doubled 这种, and it matches the shift to gloss '转向'.
This makes the summary consistent with index 16. The current text matches the summary.

'连锁' collocates with 反应/效应, not with 益处, and '产生益处' is stiff. '带来“连带”益处' renders a 'knock-on' (indirect, follow-on) benefit precisely and idiomatically. The knock-on gloss should then be changed to 连带的；间接的, as the proposal notes.
'nursery settings' is a free combination, not a fixed phrase. Listing it as a phrase hides 'setting', a high-frequency 考研 word with a sense learners must know.
'settings' is a key word, and in British childcare usage it means a provider or facility. n. 场所；机构 with the note on 托育机构 is correct for this sentence and matches the ZH '托儿机构'.
This replaces the dropped phrase. nursery n. 托儿所 is correct here and consistent with s6.

Sentence-initial 'While' here contrasts hunter-gatherer learning with western teaching (whereas). It is a key polysemous 考研 word and is unannotated. conj. 而；然而（表示对比） matches the standard dictionary sense and the ZH '而'.

With 'researchers' as the subject, 'suggested' means they put forward a view. '表明' fits only when evidence is the subject, so it is not the sense in this sentence. '提出；认为' is exact and consistent with s10.
'住户' means a household, which is wrong for the people living in an old people's home. '（养老院等机构的）入住者' is the precise sense, and '居民' is the right general sense.
In 'broke with evolutionary history', the sense is departing from an established pattern. '与……决裂', listed first, means breaking off with people or groups and does not fit. '背离；打破（传统、常规等）' is correct.
The entry is marked n., but '设法' is a verb. '尝试；努力' are noun glosses that fit 'an attempt to recover'.

But '则认为' marks a contrast that does not exist, because Swanepoel's view builds on Chaudhary's rather than opposing it. 'there are ways to' is better rendered exactly as '有办法'.

'对此我毫无歉意' is word-for-word translationese. '毫不讳言' renders the idiom naturally, and the dash fits the colon in the English.

vb.why: The current wording is clumsy, but the proposal's '钉子中凝结的熟练铁匠的劳动' momentarily reads as '凝结的铁匠'. '打制一枚钉子所付出的劳动' is precise for 'labour in a nail' and reads smoothly.

'写两本……的书，让我学到了一点' is awkward. The proposal is natural and matches the gloss '认识到'.
'转手' suggests reselling goods, which is wrong for babies. '在照料者之间换手' is natural for handing a baby from person to person.
The gloss should drop '转手' for the same reason, and '（在人与人之间）传来传去' fits 'passed between caregivers'.
It fixes a real ambiguity: as split, the subject of '可能是……原因之一' is unclear. Turning the relative clause into a modifier of '指导式教学' restores the English structure.
'由……变得更便宜推动的' is a clumsy Europeanised passive, and the change also removes the stacked '的'. The meaning is unchanged.
'想设法' translates 'attempt' twice. '试图' is precise and concise.
After '如此之深' the standard choice for a result of degree is '以至于'. '以致' tends to mark undesirable results.
This keeps the so…that gloss consistent with the corrected translation and with standard usage.
The long pre-modifier '找到更高效方法把钢制成钉子的制造商' is hard to read. The rewrite is clearer and just as accurate.
'满足的孩子' used as a modifier is unidiomatic. '更有满足感的孩子' is natural and exact for 'contented'.
The summary should match sentence 1.
Dashes set off the explanatory insertion more cleanly than commas plus '也就是', and the subject '背娃' stays visible. No change in meaning, no risk.
It removes the nominalised '这种向……的转变' and the repeated '这种'. '这样骤然转向' still refers back to the nuclear-family shift, and the meaning is intact.
The summary should match sentence 10.
'连锁益处' is not a valid collocation, and '带来……连带益处' is natural. The knock-on gloss '连锁的' should also become '连带的；间接的' so the vocabulary list matches the translation.
'nursery settings' is a collocation, not a fixed phrase. Tagging it as a phrase hides 'setting', a high-frequency 考研 word.

findings.current: 但奥尔蒂斯说，这也是一个远为个人化的问题。她认为，由于艺术与一个人联系得如此紧密，这可能会引发数据保护和隐私问题。
findings.proposed: 但奥尔蒂斯说，这还涉及深得多的个人层面。她认为，由于艺术与人本身联系如此紧密，这可能会引发数据保护和隐私问题。
findings.reason: “个人化”在中文里通常指“个性化／因人而异”（personalized），并不是这里的 personal（关乎个人、私人，接下来讲的是隐私和数据保护）。“远为个人化的问题”和“与一个人联系得如此紧密”都是翻译腔。改后保留了比较级 a lot more（深得多）和 so closely（如此紧密），意思更准、读起来也自然。

In context, 'more immediate' is about time: it contrasts with [16], where the fix needs federal funding and will take longer. '更直接' is the wrong sense, and '能更快着手的' is precise. The rest of the line is unchanged.
The sense here is time ('immediate' = something that can be done right away). '直接的' should not come first. '立即的；即时的' is correct.
This makes the summary match the corrected [17]. The time-based reading is accurate.

Read as '英格兰本土木材', it can mean wood grown in England. In the EN, 'in England' attaches to 'use', and 'home-grown' means UK-grown. Making '在英格兰' a place adverbial follows the EN structure and removes the ambiguity.

va.amended_proposed: “这些都是变革性的技术，改变着我们每天怎样花时间，也改变着哪些商业模式能够成功。”
va.why: '改变着哪些商业模式能够成功' is a good fix. But '时间安排' (schedule) is narrower than 'the ways we spend our time', and it loses the link to the highlighted 'spend our time' (gloss 花时间). '怎样花时间' is precise, keeps that link, and runs parallel with '哪些…能够成功'.

'种植木材' is a bad collocation: you plant trees, and wood is what they produce. '种树产材' is precise ('growing wood' to build homes), natural, and consistent with 植树产材 in [1] and [5]. '种' still matches 'growing'.
'颠覆' on its own as an object noun reads stiffly. 'Disruption' here means disruptive change, so '颠覆性的变革' is accurate and natural. It also ties in with '巨大的变革' in [9], and the glosses still match.
'确定权' is not a normal Chinese word. '确定人工智能议程的权力' is precise ('stranglehold … on defining the AI agenda'), reads naturally, and keeps the 确定 gloss.
'正在被摧毁' is a literal rendering of the passive progressive. '不断被毁掉' keeps the ongoing sense and reads naturally for jobs. It still matches the gloss 摧毁；毁掉.
For a proportion, Chinese uses '约占……的38%'; '占据' is for territory or position. Nothing is lost ('roughly' → 约, 'had' → 占). It is more natural.
'阻碍…技术' is a bad collocation. 'Hold back the sorts of AI technologies' means hindering their development, and the body text [14] already says '的发展'.

va.amended_proposed: v. （委婉地）表示；提出（看法）
va.why: With a person as subject, 'as Coyle suggests' means she tentatively says or puts forward a view; the ZH has 所说. '表明' (stating clearly) is the wrong sense, so the problem is real. But '暗示' (hint or imply indirectly) is not the sense here either. '表示' matches '所说' in the ZH.
The sentence has 'Not only … but' with no 'also', and the highlight is 'Not only … but'. 'not only…but (also)' is the standard dictionary form and accurately shows that 'also' is optional.

'Impetus behind those aspirations' → '为实现这些目标注入大得多的动力' is precise and much more natural than '为抱负注入推动力'. Using 目标 here and in [13] makes the reference back clear. Follow-up: the aspiration gloss (抱负；渴望) should add a 目标 sense to match.

A government's 'stated ambition' is a policy goal, and '提出……目标' is the natural, accurate rendering; '表明…雄心' is stiff. It pairs with [14]. Follow-up: the glosses for ambition (add 目标) and state (add 提出) should be aligned.
This keeps the summary consistent with the corrected [13] and [14] and removes '为抱负注入推动力'. It is accurate.

vb.amended_proposed: “几十年来，我们一直没有承担起投资国内木材供应的责任，这使我们不仅容易受到价格波动的冲击，而且随着全球需求上升、我们自己的供应减少，还不得不去争夺未来的木材供应。”
vb.why: The draft does break the causal link: 'fighting for future supplies' is a second result of 'leaving us', not a separate claim. But the proposal's '结果' drops the '使' that matches the gloss 'leave v. 使处于（某种状态）'. Keeping '这使我们' fixes the structure and keeps the gloss match.
'More immediate' contrasts with the slow federal-funding route in [16], so it is about time, not directness. '更直接' is a classic mistranslation, and '能更快着手的' is both precise and natural.
'直接的' is not the sense used here, so the time sense should lead. '立即的；即时的' is correct.
Keeps the summary consistent with the corrected [17] and fixes the same mistranslation.
'英格兰本土木材' can be parsed as 'wood grown in England'. Fronting '在英格兰' as a place adverbial removes the ambiguity at no cost.

vb.amended_proposed: “这些都是变革性的技术，它们改变着我们每天怎样花时间，也改变着哪些商业模式能够成功。”
vb.why: '改变着哪些商业模式能够成功' is a real gain in clarity. But '时间安排' (scheduling) narrows 'the ways we spend our time' and loses the match with the gloss 'spend one's time 花时间'. '我们每天怎样花时间' is idiomatic, exact, parallel with the second clause and keeps the gloss match.
'种植木材' is a mis-collocation, since you plant trees, not timber. '种树产材' fits the '植树产材' in [1]/[5] and still maps to the gloss 'grow 种植'.
A bare noun '颠覆' as object is translationese. '颠覆性的变革' is the standard Chinese for tech/economic 'disruption', echoes [9] '巨大的变革' and still maps to the gloss '颠覆'.
'确定权' is not an established word. '确定人工智能议程的权力' reads naturally and keeps the gloss match 'define 确定'.
'正在被摧毁' is literal progressive-passive translationese. '不断被毁掉' keeps the ongoing sense, is natural for jobs and still maps to the gloss '摧毁；毁掉'.
For proportions Chinese says '约占……的38%'. '占据' is for territory or position, so the proposal is more idiomatic and equally precise.
'阻碍……技术' is a collocation error. '阻碍……技术的发展' matches the body text of [14].

vb.amended_proposed: v. （委婉地）提出；认为
vb.why: Moving the person-subject sense first and dropping '表明' is right. '暗示' (hint indirectly) is not the sense in 'as Coyle suggests' (= 正如科伊尔所言). The second sense should be '认为', which is what the ZH actually renders.

vb.amended_proposed: not only…but
vb.why: Matching the headword to the text, which has no 'also', is right. But no headword in any 考研 passage uses parentheses, and another 考研 passage already uses 'not only…but' for this same case. Use that form for consistency and layout safety. The gloss already explains the pattern.

vb.amended_proposed: Confor现在呼吁为实现这些抱负注入大得多的动力，以确保我们有足够的木材来满足日益增长的需求。”
vb.why: '为实现……注入动力' fixes the translationese '为抱负注入推动力'. But switching to '目标' would break the gloss match for 'aspiration n. 抱负；渴望'. Keep '抱负', which collocates naturally with '实现'. The 雄心→抱负 shift mirrors the English ambition→aspirations and still refers back clearly.

'表明了增加植树的雄心' is accurate and acceptable Chinese, and it maps exactly to the glosses 'state v. 表明；声明' and 'ambition n. 雄心；抱负'. The proposal would break both matches without updating the glosses. The gain is mostly a matter of taste.
The summary is free paraphrase with no gloss mapping. '为实现增加植树的目标注入大得多的动力' is natural and removes the translationese '为抱负注入推动力'.

findings.current: 老年学家伊丽莎白·杜根说，在保障老年司机安全方面，部分问题在于：这些难题由不同的专业人员零敲碎打地处理，而他们各有不同的关注重点，其中包括老年学家、公路管理官员、汽车工程师等。
findings.proposed: 老年学家伊丽莎白·杜根说，在保障老年司机安全方面，部分问题在于：这些难题由关注重点各不相同的各类专业人员——包括老年学家、公路管理官员、汽车工程师等——零敲碎打地处理。
findings.reason: “including …” modifies “professionals”. In the draft, “其中包括老年学家……” comes straight after “各有不同的关注重点”, so it reads as if the focuses include gerontologists. The added clause “而他们各有……” also breaks up the noun phrase “different professionals with different focuses”.

findings.current: 通过视力测试也使这些司机的致命车祸出现了类似的降幅，不过两者结合起来似乎并无益处。
findings.proposed: 通过视力测试也让这些司机的致命车祸出现了类似的降幅，不过把两者结合起来似乎并不能带来额外的好处。
findings.reason: “no benefit from combining the two” means combining them gives no gain beyond either measure alone. “两者结合起来似乎并无益处” reads as if the combination does no good at all, which contradicts the earlier statement that each measure reduces fatal crashes.

findings.current: 往往并不清楚
findings.proposed: 并不总是清楚
findings.reason: EN [4] says “it is not always clear” (sometimes unclear). “往往” (usually/often) overstates this degree word.

findings.current: Flo Health公司与联邦贸易委员会通过一项同意令就此事达成和解，该同意令要求这家公司在共享应用用户的健康信息之前，必须征得他们明确的肯定性同意，并指示那些第三方删除其已获取的数据。
findings.proposed: Flo Health公司与联邦贸易委员会通过一项同意令就此事达成和解，该同意令要求这家公司在共享应用用户的健康信息之前，必须征得用户明确的肯定性同意，还必须指示那些第三方删除其已获取的数据。
findings.reason: In EN, “requiring the company … to get … as well as to instruct the third parties” makes the company the one that must instruct third parties. In the draft, “并指示” can be read as continuing from “该同意令”, so the order itself seems to instruct the third parties. “他们” is also vague; it should say 用户.

findings.current: 尽管联邦贸易委员会正在尽其所能，确保各类应用在处理消费者敏感健康信息方面信守对消费者的承诺，但这些健康应用上市的速度表明，这一挑战究竟有多么巨大。
findings.proposed: 尽管联邦贸易委员会正在尽其所能，确保各类应用在处理消费者敏感健康信息方面信守对消费者的承诺，但这些健康应用上市的速度表明，这是一项多么巨大的挑战。
findings.reason: “demonstrates just how immense a challenge this is” is an exclamatory statement. “究竟有多么巨大” sounds like a question and is unidiomatic in a declarative sentence.

findings.current: 各州已开始实施各自的解决方案，以加强保护消费者生成的健康数据。
findings.proposed: 一些州已开始实施自己的解决方案，以加强对消费者生成的健康数据的保护。
findings.reason: Bare plural “States” (as opposed to federal action) does not mean every state. [15] and [16] name only California, Virginia, Colorado and Utah, so “各州” (each/all states) overgeneralizes. “加强保护……数据” also reads more naturally as “加强对……的保护”.

findings.current: 杜根说：“我们需要更充分的证据，弄清是什么让司机变得不安全”，也要弄清什么能有所帮助。
findings.proposed: 杜根说，“我们需要更充分的证据，弄清是什么让司机开车变得不安全”，以及什么能有所帮助。
findings.reason: 冒号引出直接引语后，引号外又接“也要弄清……”，结构不通，像是凭空多出一句叙述。“让司机变得不安全”容易理解成司机自身处境危险，而原文 unsafe 指开车有危险。改用逗号嵌入引语，加上“开车”二字。

findings.current: 要让不安全的老年司机不再上路，最大的挑战之一是说服他们：是时候交出车钥匙了。
findings.proposed: 要让开车不安全的老年司机不再上路，最大的挑战之一是说服他们：是时候交出车钥匙了。
findings.reason: 中文“不安全的司机”搭配别扭，还可能理解成司机自己有危险；unsafe drivers 指开车有危险的司机。

findings.current: 要让不安全的老年司机不再上路
findings.proposed: 要让开车不安全的老年司机不再上路
findings.reason: 同第1句：“不安全的司机”搭配别扭、有歧义。

findings.current: 她说：“并没有一个国家老年司机研究院。”
findings.proposed: 她说：“并没有一家国家老年司机研究院。”
findings.reason: “一个国家老年司机研究院”里，“一个国家”容易被当成一个词（a country），造成误读；机构的量词也应该用“家”。

findings.current: adv. 究竟；真正
findings.proposed: adv. （加强语气）到底；何等
findings.reason: just how immense 中的 just 是加强语气，不是“真正”；释义要与改后译文中的“何等”对应。

findings.current: 如果看看你手机上的应用，你很可能至少有一个与健康相关的应用——而且多半有好几个。
findings.proposed: 看看你手机上的应用，其中很可能至少有一个与健康相关——而且多半有好几个。
findings.reason: “如果看看”缺主语，后面又重复“你”，“应用”也出现两次，是硬译 If you look…, you have…；用中文常见的“看看……”就足以表达条件。

findings.current: 护理与健康应用评审组织最近的研究发现，市场上有350,000款健康应用，其中仅2020年一年就推出了90,000款。
findings.proposed: 护理与健康应用评审组织最近的研究发现，市场上有35万款健康应用，其中仅2020年一年就推出了9万款。
findings.reason: 中文行文中这样的大数通常用“万”作单位，照搬英文的千分位逗号写法不地道。

findings.current: 联邦贸易委员会在一份诉状中指控：“尽管有明确的隐私声明，该公司仍掌控了用户敏感的生育数据，并将其与第三方共享。”
findings.proposed: 联邦贸易委员会在一份诉状中指控：“尽管有明确的隐私声明，该公司仍掌控了用户的敏感生育数据，并将其与第三方共享。”
findings.reason: “用户敏感的生育数据”读起来像“用户敏感”，修饰关系不清；应为“用户的敏感生育数据”。

findings.current: include
findings.proposed: including
findings.reason: In 'including gerontologists, highway administration officials…' the word works as a preposition introducing examples, not as a verb. The headword should be 'including', with the gloss changed to match (see the next finding).

findings.current: v. 包括
findings.proposed: prep. 包括
findings.reason: 'including' here is a preposition (prep.), not a verb. The POS must match how the word is used in this sentence.

findings.proposed: while=conj. 而（表示对比）
findings.reason: 'while a few consider a report a breach…' uses contrastive 'while' (而), which is a frequently tested 考研 point. The sentence has no entry for it.

findings.proposed: while=conj. 虽然；尽管
findings.reason: 'While these apps have a great deal to offer, …' uses concessive 'while' (the ZH has 虽然). This is a key 考研 sense, and k23 annotates 'although' in the same way, but here it has no entry.

findings.proposed: while=conj. 尽管；虽然
findings.reason: 'While the FTC is doing what it can…, the rate … demonstrates…' uses concessive 'while' (the ZH has 尽管). It is the key word for the sentence's logic, and it has no entry.

findings.current: 但杜根说，我们需要做更多工作来提高安全性。
findings.proposed: 杜根说，不过我们仍需做更多工作来提高安全性。
findings.reason: “But” contrasts with sentences 14–15, where Dugan says self-driving cars won't solve the problem, so we still have to act. Putting the contrast in front of “杜根说” makes it look as if Dugan is disagreeing with someone, but sentences 14–15 are her own words. Moving “不过” after “杜根说” and adding “仍” matches the English logic.

findings.current: 部分问题在于各类专业人员零敲碎打地处理这些难题
findings.proposed: 保障老年司机安全的部分问题在于，相关难题由各类专业人员零敲碎打地处理
findings.reason: In the summary, “这些难题” has no antecedent: nothing before it names these difficulties. The EN frame “part of the problem in keeping older drivers safe” is also missing.

findings.current: 自动驾驶汽车就解决不了车祸问题，我们需要90岁老人也能开得舒舒服服的汽车。
findings.proposed: 自动驾驶汽车就解决不了车祸问题，但我们仍需做更多工作来提高安全性：如果人要活到100岁，就需要90岁老人也能开得舒舒服服的汽车。
findings.reason: The summary leaves out the “But we need to do more” turn. As a result, “we need cars a 90-year-old can drive” looks like part of the self-driving-car point instead of a contrast with it, and the 100-year-life condition behind the quote is lost.

findings.current: 《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条授权该委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为发起执法行动，这意味着，如果某家公司的隐私做法具有误导性，或给消费者造成了不合理的损害，联邦贸易委员会也只能在事后采取行动。
findings.proposed: 《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条授权该委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为发起执法行动，这意味着，只有在某家公司的隐私做法具有误导性或给消费者造成了不合理的损害之后，联邦贸易委员会才能采取行动。
findings.reason: After “如果”, “也只能” brings in an unwanted “even so” nuance. The point is that the FTC can act only after the fact, once practices have misled people or caused harm. “只有……之后……才能” states this directly and keeps the after-the-fact idea.

va.why: In the current line, “其中包括” can attach to 关注重点. The proposal keeps every element (different professionals, different focuses, the examples, “等”) and makes it clear that including… modifies the professionals.

In context, “no benefit from combining” means no gain beyond either measure alone. “并无益处” wrongly says the combination does no good at all. “似乎并不能带来额外的好处” is accurate and still matches the benefit gloss 好处.
EN [4] says “not always clear”. “往往” (often) overstates this, and “并不总是” is exact.
In EN the company has to instruct the third parties. “还必须指示” makes the company the agent without ambiguity, and “用户” replaces the vague “他们”.
“表明，这一挑战究竟有多么巨大” sounds like a question inside a statement. “这是一项多么巨大的挑战” keeps the exclamatory emphasis of “just how immense” and reads naturally.
Bare “States” here does not mean every state, and [15]–[16] name only four, so “各州” overgeneralizes. “一些州…自己的…加强对…的保护” is accurate and more natural.

“让司机变得不安全” can mean the drivers themselves are in danger; “开车变得不安全” is what “unsafe drivers” means. “以及什么能有所帮助” follows on from 弄清, just as “and what can help” does in EN, so the stray narrated clause “也要弄清” goes away.
“unsafe drivers” means drivers whose driving is dangerous. “不安全的司机” is awkward and ambiguous, and “开车不安全的” is exact.
Same fix as sentence 1. It keeps the summary consistent and unambiguous.
“一个国家老年司机研究院” can be parsed as “一个国家” (one country). “一家” removes this misreading and is a correct measure word for an institution.

va.amended_proposed: adv. （加强语气）到底；究竟
va.why: Adding a usage label for intensifying “just” is a real improvement, since just has many senses (仅仅/刚刚/正好). But “何等” matches nothing in the revised ZH, which uses 多么, and it glosses “how”, not “just”. “究竟/到底” is the standard dictionary rendering for “just how…”.

This rewrite keeps every element (look at apps, chances are → 很可能, at least one, health-related, probably several). It removes the subjectless “如果看看” and the repeated 你 and 应用, so it is clearly more idiomatic.
The figures are identical, and Chinese prose normally writes 35万 and 9万 rather than English-style thousands separators.
“用户敏感的生育数据” can read as “data users are sensitive about”. “用户的敏感生育数据” makes “sensitive” modify the data, as in EN.
“including” that introduces examples is a preposition, and dictionaries list it as prep. The headword should match the form used in the sentence.
POS must match the use in this sentence: prep. 包括.
Contrastive “while” (而) is a key 考研 point, the ZH shows the contrast with 则, and the entry conj. 而（表示对比） is correct.
Concessive “while” is a core 考研 sense, the ZH uses 虽然, and conj. 虽然；尽管 is correct for this sentence.
Concessive “while” carries the logic of the sentence, the ZH uses 尽管, and conj. 尽管；虽然 is correct.
“但杜根说” suggests Dugan is contradicting someone else, but [14]–[15] are her own words. “杜根说，不过我们仍需…” places the contrast inside her statement, as “But we need…, said Dugan” does.

va.amended_proposed: 在保障老年司机安全方面，部分问题在于相关难题由各类专业人员零敲碎打地处理
va.why: The problem is real: “这些难题” has no antecedent in the summary and the frame “in keeping older drivers safe” is missing. “保障老年司机安全的部分问题” is a slightly clumsy noun phrase, so this wording mirrors sentence [6] instead and reads cleanly before “，并指出…”.

The current summary drops the “But we need to do more” turn and the 100-year-life condition, so the last clause looks like a continuation of the self-driving point. The proposal restores both accurately.

va.amended_proposed: 《联邦贸易委员会法》第5条授权该委员会对不公平或欺骗性行为发起执法行动，这意味着，如果某家公司的隐私做法具有误导性，或给消费者造成了不合理的损害，联邦贸易委员会只能在事后采取行动。
va.why: The problem is real: “也只能” adds an “even so” nuance that is not in EN. But the proposal drops “事后”, which matches the highlighted phrase “after the fact” (glossed 事后), and “做法具有误导性…之后” is awkward. Deleting “也” is the minimal exact fix and keeps the EN order “only act after the fact if…”.

vb.why: Real ambiguity: in the draft, “其中包括” follows “关注重点”, so the list reads as examples of focuses. The proposal makes the list modify the professionals and keeps “different professionals with different focuses” as one noun phrase. Accurate and grammatical.
“并无益处” can be read as “combining is useless”. The point is that combining adds no gain beyond either measure alone, and “额外的好处” states that exactly.
“not always clear” means sometimes unclear. “往往” (usually) overstates it, and “并不总是清楚” is exact.
“还必须指示” makes clear that the company, not the order, instructs the third parties, and “用户” is clearer than “他们”. Meaning unchanged and the scope is now unambiguous.
“表明……究竟有多么巨大” reads like a question in a declarative sentence. “这是一项多么巨大的挑战” is idiomatic and renders “just how immense a challenge this is” faithfully.
A bare plural “States” (state level as opposed to federal) does not mean every state, and only four are named, so “各州” overgeneralises. “加强对……的保护” is also more natural. No new error.

vb.amended_proposed: 杜根说，“我们需要更充分的证据，弄清是什么让司机开车变得不安全”，也要弄清什么能有所帮助。
vb.why: Adding “开车” fixes a real ambiguity (the drivers being in danger, versus their driving being dangerous). Switching the colon to a comma suits a partial quote. But a bare “，以及什么能有所帮助。” after the closing quote dangles in Chinese, so I keep “也要弄清”, which already renders the coordination clearly.
“不安全的老年司机” is ambiguous (the drivers themselves at risk) and an odd collocation. “开车不安全的” gives the intended sense of unsafe drivers.
Same fix as sentence 1, applied to the summary for consistency and precision.
“一个国家老年司机研究院” can be misparsed as “一个国家” (a country). “家” is the correct measure word for an institution, so the change fixes a real misreading risk.

vb.amended_proposed: adv. （加强语气）到底；究竟
vb.why: Labelling “just” as an intensifier is right, and “真正” is not the sense here. But the revised ZH (index 4) uses “多么”, not “何等”, so the stated link fails. “何等” is really a rendering of “how”. A standard dictionary sense for “just how” is 到底/究竟.
The draft is translationese: subjectless “如果看看”, then “你” and “应用” each repeated. The proposal is idiomatic and keeps the meaning, including “chances are” and “probably several”.
In Chinese prose, large numbers are normally written with 万 (35万, 9万). Copying the English comma format is unidiomatic. Values unchanged.
“用户敏感的生育数据” can be parsed as “users are sensitive”. “用户的敏感生育数据” makes the modifier structure clear.
Introducing examples after a noun, “including” is a preposition (OED and learner dictionaries list it as prep.), so the headword should be “including”.
The POS must match the use in this sentence, so “prep. 包括” is correct and “v.” is wrong.
Contrastive “while” (而) is a key 考研 word that learners must memorise, and sentence 4 has no entry for it. The ZH “则” reflects it.
Concessive “while” (虽然) is a core 考研 sense, it drives the sentence logic, and the ZH uses 虽然. It is unannotated, while k23 annotates “although”.
Concessive “while” (尽管) is the key logic word of this sentence and the ZH uses 尽管. It is unannotated.

“But” belongs to Dugan's own statement and contrasts with her points in 14–15. “但杜根说” wrongly suggests she is contradicting someone. “杜根说，不过我们仍需……” keeps the logic, and “仍” is implied by the contrast.
In the summary, “这些难题” has no antecedent, and the frame “part of the problem in keeping older drivers safe” is missing. The proposal fixes both, and the sentence still parses with “并指出” following.
Without the “But we need to do more” turn and the 100-year-life condition, the 90-year-old-car point reads as part of the self-driving argument. The proposal restores the logic accurately.
After “如果”, “也只能” adds an unwanted “even then” nuance. “只有在……之后……才能” states the after-the-fact limit exactly, which is also the point the exam tests.

findings.current: 自最近的极端高温以来，得克萨斯州的天气或许已经转凉，但本月在奥斯汀召开的州教育委员会会议上，“温度”却会很高，届时官员们要辩论得州学校如何讲授气候变化。
findings.proposed: 前不久的极端高温过后，得克萨斯州的天气或许已经转凉，但本月在奥斯汀召开的州教育委员会会议上，“温度”却会很高，届时官员们将就得州学校如何讲授气候变化展开辩论。
findings.reason: “自……以来……已经转凉”是照搬 since 的翻译腔。这里的 since 意思是“那波高温过后”，改成“……过后”更自然。“要辩论”改为“将就……展开辩论”，更符合中文书面语的习惯。意思不变。

findings.current: “反对这一切全球气候变化恐慌的科学家，跟煽动这种恐慌的科学家一样多。”她声称。
findings.proposed: “对于全球气候变化引发的种种恐慌，反对的科学家和煽动的科学家一样多。”她声称。

findings.current: 在许多社会研究课程中，气候变化同样没那么突出。

findings.current: 美国国家科学教育中心是一个由科学家和教师组成的非营利组织，该中心去年的一项研究考察了全国各州公立学校在科学课上如何探讨气候变化，结果给美国勉强半数的州评了B+或更高的等级。
findings.proposed: 美国国家科学教育中心是一个由科学家和教师组成的非营利组织，该中心去年的一项研究考察了全国各州公立学校在科学课上如何探讨气候变化，结果只给美国约半数的州评了B+或更高的等级。
findings.reason: “勉强半数的州”是 barely half 的生硬直译，中文一般说“勉强及格”“勉强过半”，不说“勉强半数的州”。用“只给……约半数”更地道，“只/仅”也在 barely 的释义（仅仅）之内。

findings.proposed: 只给约半数的州评了B+或更高的等级

findings.current: “我认为问题在于：一个开发商实际上是在建酒店，却把它伪装成不是酒店的样子，难道不应该像对待酒店那样对待他、向他征税、对他实施监管吗？”霍恩说。

findings.current: 靠……维持；由……提供服务
findings.proposed: 靠……维持；由……支撑
findings.reason: 这里说的是旅游业要靠短期来的游客撑着，并不是游客为旅游业“提供服务”。按字面理解的“由……提供服务”放在这句里讲不通，会误导学生。另外它只是 service 的被动用法，不算固定短语。

findings.current: 大赚一笔
findings.proposed: 以高价；换得一大笔钱

findings.current: open the potential for
findings.proposed: potential for
findings.reason: open the potential for 是自由组合，不是固定短语。真正要学的是名词 potential for（……的可能性）。改为 “potential for=……的可能（性）”，学生也能看出这里的 potential 是名词，和 [14] 的形容词 potential（潜在的）区分开。

findings.proposed: greater=adj. 大……地区的（指城市及其周边地区）
findings.reason: Greater Seacoast 里的 Greater 表示“大……地区”（同 Greater London），和平时“更大的”意思不同，译文也译成了“大海岸地区”，值得标出来。

va.why: Current matches the file. “自……以来……已经转凉” is a calque of since. The new line keeps every clause: may have cooled → 或许已经转凉, recent → 前不久的, will be high, as officials debate → 届时……将就……展开辩论. It reads more naturally.

va.amended_proposed: “围绕全球气候变化的种种恐慌，反对的科学家和煽动的科学家一样多。”她声称。
va.why: The problem is real: “这一切全球气候变化恐慌” is awkward. But “全球气候变化引发的” adds a causal claim the English does not make. “the panic of global climate change” means the panic over climate change, so the neutral “围绕……的” is more exact. The topic-comment structure is kept.
social studies is the US school subject. “社会研究课程” suggests courses that do social research, which is misleading. “社会学科课程” is accurate.
The subject is the same in both clauses, so the repeated 她 is redundant. Nothing is lost.
“勉强半数的州” is a stiff calque. “只给……约半数” keeps barely (只 = only) and is accurate: just about half of the states.
“作用有限的衡量基准” keeps limited and collocates better than “有局限的衡量基准”.
“即便……却” is a mismatched connective pair. “即便……仍” is correct. Turning the agentless passive into “仍有人在向教师分发……” is faithful and reads more naturally.
Current matches the summary. The change is consistent with the accepted fix to sentence 9.
Current matches the summary. The change is consistent with the accepted fix to sentence 11.
Current matches the summary. “低龄儿童的课程和……科目” can be misread as both nouns belonging to 低龄儿童. The new wording matches the sentence 13 translation and removes the ambiguity.
“住房倡导者” does not say what is being advocated. housing advocates campaign for people's access to affordable housing, and “住房权益倡导者” is the standard rendering.
Current matches the summary. The change is consistent with index 10.
“就将属于违法” is clumsy. “就会成为违法行为” is clear, keeps the counterfactual (若获通过……就会), and matches the make it illegal gloss.

Every element is kept: really → 实际上, disguising it as not a hotel → 伪装成非酒店设施, and treated/taxed/regulated like a hotel → 按酒店的标准来对待他、向他征税、对他实施监管. It removes the repeated 对待 and the odd comparison of a person to a hotel.
“多建很多房子” stacks 多 on 很多, and 我们 is repeated. “必须建造多得多的住房” renders build a lot more exactly as a comparative and matches the a lot more gloss (多得多).

industry appears twice in sentence 8 (tourist industry / tourism industry) and is a core 考研 word, but it is not annotated anywhere in k26. n. 行业；产业 is the correct sense. Highlight the first occurrence.
In this sentence the short-term visitors keep the tourism industry going; they do not provide a service to it. “由……提供服务” is the literal sense and makes no sense here. “靠……维持；由……支撑” is right.

for a fortune is a price phrase: for a large sum of money. “大赚一笔” describes the result, not the meaning, and hides the structure. “以高价；换得一大笔钱” is exact. The ZH translation can keep 大赚一笔 as idiomatic phrasing.

open the potential for is a free combination, not a set phrase, so presenting it as a phrase misleads learners. The noun potential for (possibility of) is the item worth learning, and it contrasts with adj. potential in [14]. Apply it as the reason states: headword “potential for”, gloss “……的可能（性）”, highlight “potential for”.

va.amended_proposed: greater=adj. 大……地区的（用于地名前，指该地及其周边一带）
va.why: Greater before a place name (Greater London, Greater Seacoast) is a sense learners should know; it explains the translation 大海岸地区. But Seacoast is a region, not a city, so “指城市及其周边地区” is wrong for this sentence. The parenthetical is broadened.

vb.why: The '自……以来……已经转凉' structure copies 'since' word for word; 'since' here means 'after', so '……过后' is precise and idiomatic. '将就……展开辩论' reads better than '要辩论' and keeps the meaning.

vb.amended_proposed: “对于全球气候变化的种种恐慌，反对的科学家和煽动的科学家一样多。”她声称。
vb.why: The current '这一切全球气候变化恐慌' is ungrammatical, so a fix is needed. The proposed '全球气候变化引发的' makes climate change the cause of the panic. Hardy says scientists are pushing the panic, so the source is neutral ('panic of' means panic about). Dropping '引发' keeps that neutrality and the rest of the improvement.
'社会研究课程' invites a misreading as research courses. 'Social studies' is a K-12 school subject, and '社会学科课程' says that clearly. It also matches the gloss's second sense.
The repeated subject pronoun '她' is classic translationese. Dropping it is natural and the meaning is unchanged.
'勉强半数的州' is an unnatural literal rendering. '只给……约半数' is the standard journalistic rendering of 'barely half' and keeps the 'only' nuance (仅仅 is in the gloss).
'有局限的衡量基准' is a stiff collocation. '作用有限的' conveys 'limited benchmark' (of limited value as a measure) naturally and still matches the gloss '有限的'.

vb.amended_proposed: 布兰奇指出，即便越来越多的官方指导方针和教科书反映了有关气候变化的科学共识，传达更偏颇观点的非官方教育材料也仍在分发到教师手中。
vb.why: The diagnosis is right: '即便……却' is a mismatched connective pair. The proposed fix adds an agent ('有人') that the source doesn't have. It also creates the clunky string '分发传达更偏颇观点的…'. Material as subject with '分发到……手中' is normal Chinese (cf. 物资已分发到灾民手中), so only the connective needs fixing: '也仍在'.
Keeps the summary consistent with the fix to sentence 9 ('勉强半数的州' is unnatural).
Keeps the summary consistent with the fix to sentence 11.
The current summary wording is ambiguous: it can be read as 'young children's (courses and subjects)'. The proposed wording matches the sentence 13 translation and removes the ambiguity.
In '住房倡导者' it is unclear what is being advocated. '住房权益倡导者' is the established rendering of 'housing advocates' and keeps '倡导者' from the gloss.
Keeps the summary consistent with the fix to sentence 3.
'就将属于违法' is awkward ('将' with the stative verb '属于', and '违法' left incomplete). '就会成为违法行为' is natural and matches the gloss for 'make it illegal for'.
'伪装成不是酒店的样子' is wordy, and '像对待酒店那样对待他' repeats '对待' awkwardly. The proposal is concise and natural, keeps all three verbs (treated/taxed/regulated), and keeps the meaning.
'多建很多房子' stacks '多' and '很多' redundantly. '建造多得多的住房' renders 'build a lot more' precisely and matches the gloss '多得多'. The subject '我们' is clear from the 'if' clause.
'Industry' appears twice in this sentence (tourist industry / tourism industry), is a core 考研 word, and is annotated nowhere in k26. Each passage is reviewed on its own.

'由……提供服务' says the visitors provide services to the industry, which is the reverse of the meaning here: the tourism industry depends on short-term visitors. '靠……维持；由……支撑' is the correct contextual sense.

'For a fortune' is a prepositional phrase meaning 'for a large sum'. Glossing it as the verb phrase '大赚一笔' mismatches its structure. '以高价；换得一大笔钱' gives the exact sense and still lines up with the free rendering in the ZH.

vb.amended_proposed: Headword 'potential for' (highlighted text: "potential for"), gloss: ……的可能（性）
vb.why: Annotating the noun 'potential for' teaches the noun sense of a core word and separates it from the adjective 'potential' in [14]; 'open' itself is a basic verb. Wedging 有趣的是 between 表明 and its object copies English word order. Moving it to the front reads naturally and doesn't change the meaning.

va.why: k33[8]: 'at risk' here means at risk of deteriorating. '面临危险的塑料物品' is vague and odd when said of objects. '面临损毁风险' is exact and natural, and the rest of the line is unchanged.
k34[8]: 'already' modifies 'is happening', so 已经 belongs on 在发生, not on 有迹象. The proposal fixes this and leaves the rest of the line unchanged.

k34[9]: '事实往往证明，他们比大学毕业生更敬业、更忠诚' keeps every element: 'often', the 'prove' sense and the comparison with graduates. 'employees' is implied by 敬业. It is clearly more natural than the calque '证明自己是更……的员工'.

findings.current: 雇主既要说明理由，又要在程序上公正行事。
findings.proposed: 雇主既要拿出正当理由，又要在程序上公正行事。
findings.reason: Here "show cause" is a legal term. It means proving that a valid reason exists, picking up "good cause" from [1] and "justified" from [2]. 说明理由 only means stating or explaining some reason, which weakens the legal requirement. The sentence's own gloss already says 说明（正当）理由.

findings.current: 而且，企业由于要承担雇佣安排出问题的负担，付给员工的工资更少。
findings.proposed: 而且，由于雇佣安排一旦出问题，负担要由企业承担，企业给员工开的工资也就更低。
findings.reason: 承担雇佣安排出问题的负担 copies the English "the burden of X going wrong" word for word and reads as translationese. The meaning is the burden that falls on the firm if the employment arrangement goes wrong. 付给员工的工资更少 is also less natural than 工资更低. The proposed line keeps the causal link (because firms carry the burden → pay staff less).

findings.current: 光是艺术家和科学家都感兴趣的东西，因此可以构成合作的基础。
findings.proposed: 艺术家和科学家都对光感兴趣，因此光可以构成合作的基础。
findings.reason: Opening the sentence with “光是” makes most readers take it as “仅仅是”, so the sentence is ambiguous. “……的东西” is also colloquial translationese. The rewrite makes the subject clear, says the same thing and keeps “……和……都” (both…and).

findings.current: 科学家正越来越多地寻找视觉艺术家，请他们帮助自己向新的受众传播研究工作。

findings.reason: “传播研究工作” is a bad collocation: you spread findings, not “work”. Here “their work” means their research output, so “研究成果” is the natural word.

findings.current: 在《自然》杂志关于艺术家与研究人员合作的一系列文章中，读者用来描述自己参与艺术与科学合作经历的词语，就包括上面这几个。

findings.reason: “读者用来描述自己参与艺术与科学合作经历的词语” stacks a long modifier in front of the noun and drops a needed 的, so it can be parsed as “参与[……合作经历]”. The rewrite breaks it into a time clause and keeps “some of the words” (用到的就有).

findings.current: 回应《自然》这项调查的艺术家比科学家少；不过，有几位受访者指出，艺术家并不只是帮助科学家满足传播需求。

findings.current: 老板只需按合同规定向雇员发出解雇通知即可的日子，早已一去不复返了。

findings.reason: “——而且矛盾的是——” copies the English dash parenthesis word for word and reads as translationese. In Chinese, “因此，矛盾的是，” carries the same logic.

findings.reason: The normal legal collocation is “条款适用于……”, not “条款用于……”. “适用于” also matches the gloss for “apply to”.

findings.current: 严格的解雇规定会对生产率增长产生不利影响，并且既妨碍繁荣，也妨碍整体福祉。

findings.reason: “并且既……也……” is a clumsy run of connectors. A plain “既……又……” is idiomatic and matches the both…and gloss.

……即可的日子 crams a whole clause in front of 日子. The 这样的日子 version is clearly more idiomatic and equally precise.
In Chinese it is people who get dismissed, not jobs (工作免遭解雇 is a mismatch). 使他们免遭 fixes this, keeps 保护……免遭 for guard…from, and does not change the meaning.
——而且矛盾的是—— copies the English dash parenthesis. 因此，矛盾的是， is natural Chinese and keeps both logical markers.

并且既……也…… piles up connectors. With 规定 as the clear subject, ……产生不利影响，既……又…… still reads as three effects of the regulations, and it is more idiomatic.

Nor should is not a fixed phrase. It is sentence-initial nor followed by inversion. The headword should be the single word nor, with only Nor highlighted, as in k36 [15].
Once the headword is the single word nor, the gloss needs a POS and should not include should. This matches k36 [15].
帮助某人做某事 is the meaning of assist sb in doing/to do and would mislead learners. assist sb with sth means helping sb with a matter, which the proposed gloss states correctly.

va.why: '收蛋' can be read as buying up eggs as a middleman. Brown is a contract farmer collecting eggs from his own 13,000 hens for NestFresh, and '养鸡产蛋' says this accurately and naturally.
In a survey context 'most popular ways' means the most widely used ways. '最常采用的做法' is more accurate and less translationese than '最受欢迎的方式', and '包括' still carries 'Among'.
It is clearer to say that 'it' refers to returning to work, and putting the 72% after the group reads better. '退休后' renders 'once retired' faithfully here. Nothing is lost.
'多出来的这些年' gives the sense of 'extended years' (the extra years from living longer) more naturally than '延长的这些岁月'. '关键是要' renders 'is key' accurately, and 'but' is kept.
'更近一些时候' is a word-for-word calque. '近些年' is natural, and the '也' in the sentence keeps the link to the organic-egg example before it. The time reference does not change.

'牧场饲养鸡蛋' collocates badly and splits the list of attributes. Putting the three attributes together and moving the eggs into '多花钱买鸡蛋' keeps every element of the EN (premium attributes, paying more, eggs) and reads cleanly.

In the current line '其中的一环' has nothing clear to refer to. The EN says the scene is part of climate-friendly eggs, i.e. part of how they are produced. Making '生产' explicit is a fair rendering of that, and the reordered line keeps all the information.
'1985年1月10%' is a cramped run of numbers. '1985年1月创下的10%这一历史最低点' separates the date from the value with no change in meaning, so it is more natural and at least as precise.
'最终退休' matches the parallel verb phrases '结婚、生儿育女' and the EN 'ultimately retiring'. '最终的退休' is a needless nominalisation.

'sustainable-egg' is an ad hoc compound, not a word to memorise, and labelling it 'adj.' is odd. The core word learners need is 'sustainable', which appears nowhere else in the passage. Whether the highlight can mark only part of the hyphenated token is a technical matter for the orchestrator.
This pairs with 10. 'adj. 可持续的' is the exact sense of 'sustainable' in 'sustainable-egg rollout'.

'在头脑上' is not idiomatic Chinese. In 'staying mentally fit', mentally refers to the mind and cognitive sharpness, so the standard renderings '精神上；智力上' are correct. '心理上' is rightly removed because depression is listed separately.
This is the same unidiomatic gloss in the same collocation ('keep mentally fit'), so it gets the same fix for consistency.
'Even more surprising is that' is a grammatical inversion, not a lexical phrase. Labelling it 短语 implies a fixed expression to memorise. The word to learn is 'surprising', which index 15 adds.
'surprising' is a core word that should be memorised, and 'adj. 令人惊讶的' is the correct POS and sense in 'Even more surprising is that…'. This replaces the dropped pattern entry.
'Among … is' is an inversion of 'Y is among X', not a phrase, so labelling it 短语 is misleading. The sentence keeps nine valid entries, and dropping it is consistent with index 14.

vb.amended_proposed: 过去三十年间，达到退休年龄的人当中，属于劳动力人口的比例翻了一番。
vb.why: The reviewer is right that the current text has the statistic backwards. Sentence 15 (20% of people 65+ in the workforce, up from 10%) shows it is the participation rate. I dropped '仍', though: many of these people are unretirees who went back to work, so 'still' adds a meaning the English doesn't have. This wording also matches '属于劳动力人口' in sentence 15.
'为……公司收蛋' can easily be read as buying up eggs for the company like a middle-man. Brown keeps the 13,000 chickens on his own land, and '养鸡产蛋' says that accurately and idiomatically.
In a survey, 'most popular ways' means the most common ones. '最受欢迎的方式' is translationese and slightly off; '最常采用的做法' is precise.
'it' refers to returning to work, and '这' is ambiguous because it could point back to keeping mentally fit. '在受访的……中，约72%' also reads better than the stacked '约72%受访的……'. The meaning is unchanged.
'为延长的这些岁月' is stilted. '为多出来的这些年做好规划' says 'the extended years' accurately in natural Chinese, and '关键是' matches 'is key'.
'更近一些时候' is a word-for-word calque. '近些年' is natural and points to the same time, after the organic-egg example in sentence 11.
'牧场饲养鸡蛋' collocates badly (it reads as 'raising eggs') and muddles the list. Moving 鸡蛋 into '多花钱买鸡蛋' keeps the three attributes parallel and the meaning exact.

In '而这正是其中的一环', '其中' has nothing clear to refer to. The new wording makes the scene part of climate-friendly egg production, which is what the English says ('part of … climate-friendly eggs'). '生产' is only implied, adds no new information, and reads naturally.
'1985年1月10%' runs the numbers together and is awkward to read. '1985年1月创下的10%这一历史最低点' separates the date from the value without changing the meaning.
'最终的退休' is a nominalisation that breaks the parallel with the verb phrases '结婚、生儿育女'. '以及最终退休' restores the parallel (getting married / starting a family / ultimately retiring).

'sustainable-egg' is a one-off compound, not a dictionary word. 'sustainable' is the core word learners need to memorise. ann_lib.find supports a bracketed partial highlight, e.g. sustainable{[sustainable]-egg}, so the highlight can land on 'sustainable' alone.
This follows from the headword change. 'adj. 可持续的' is the exact meaning of 'sustainable' and matches the gloss used in k10, k21 and k29.
'在头脑上' is not idiomatic Chinese. In 'staying mentally fit' the word means mental sharpness, so '精神上；智力上' is accurate and standard.
Same unidiomatic '在头脑上' in the same collocation ('keep mentally fit'). It should be fixed the same way for consistency.

The current entry is accurate, labelled as a 表语前置倒装 pattern, and useful for 考研 long-sentence analysis. Other 考研 entries follow the same convention ('much more important are', 'among…were', 'nor should'). Dropping only this one is a matter of taste and would make the passages inconsistent. The reviewer also concedes it is not misleading.

This depends on #14, which is rejected. 'surprising' sits inside the kept pattern's highlight, so a separate entry would overlap it. It is also basic vocabulary (from surprise) that the coverage check does not require.

'……当中包括（表语前置的倒装）' correctly explains the inverted 'Among … is' structure, which is a classic 考研 long-sentence point. It is consistent with the 'among…were' entry elsewhere in the 考研 annotations, so removing it is a matter of taste, not a fix for an error.

va.why: The current text matches the file. In the current ZH the single 都 binds to the two lives, so 'all of us' is weakened. 每个人都 restores 'all', 无论是……还是…… gives 'in both' naturally, and 工作中 reads better than 职业生活. Every clause is still covered.

va.amended_proposed: 这些法规旨在禁止暗黑模式，这意味着禁止企业让消费者承受“令人困惑的措辞或不必要的步骤，比如强迫他们点击浏览多个页面，或者听取他们不应选择退出的理由”所带来的负担。
va.why: The problem is real: 承受措辞/步骤 is an awkward collocation and 为什么……的理由 is redundant. But the proposal puts 消费者 after the quote, so 他们 inside the quote comes before its antecedent and can be misread as 企业. It also wraps a very long 用……来 frame around the quote and adds 种种, which the English does not have. The amendment keeps 消费者 first, fixes the collocation with 承受……所带来的负担 (= burden consumers with X), and leaves the quote as a single unit.
损害消费者的选择 is an unnatural collocation. Here consumer choice means consumers' freedom to choose, and 消费者的选择权 is the standard Chinese term. The meaning is unchanged and the line reads better.

va.amended_proposed: 立法者和监管机构正慢慢着手处理暗黑模式问题上的模糊之处，最近的举措来自州一级。
va.why: 最近一次 has no head noun, so a fix is justified. 举措出现在 is still a bit stiff, though. 来自州一级 fits lawmakers and regulators acting at the state level and leads into the California example.

The summary lists 各种手法, then gives a 服务 as the example, which is a category mismatch. The proposal gives the tactic itself (making services easy to sign up for and hard to cancel), which matches the passage.
The current text matches the file. Putting 包括……在内的一系列行为 before the verb is the normal Chinese order, while 包括 hanging after 并无差别 is translationese. All three items and the meaning are kept.
With bare 把重点放在了慈善捐赠上, a reader could think these students took up donating. In context (s5) it is their reading and discussion topic. Adding 学习 removes the misreading at no cost to precision.
另一组学生仍为52% has no proper subject: the students are not 52%, the proportion is. 这一比例 fixes the logic, and s11 confirms the meaning.

va.amended_proposed: adv. 而是；作为替代
va.why: '而' alone is too vague to count as a gloss. But 转而 means one person switching to something else, which does not fit a second, parallel group that studied a different topic. 而是 / 作为替代 gives the actual sense here: in place of meat ethics.

'the other half' here is a free, literal combination (the remaining 50% of students), not a set phrase. Listing it as a 短语 could suggest the idiom meaning ('spouse' / 'how the other half lives'). Sentence 6 still has three other annotations, and 'Half' in s5 is likewise not annotated.
In 'a single ethics lesson', single means 'just one'. 单一的 usually means homogeneous or undiversified (单一的经济结构), which is misleading here. 仅仅一个的；单个的 is accurate.

In 'the ambiguity around dark patterns', around means 'concerning'. This sense is common in journalism, many learners do not know it, and it is not annotated yet. 'prep. 围绕；关于' is correct for this sentence and matches the ZH 暗黑模式问题上的.

vb.why: k39 s1: In the current ZH, 都 attaches to the two kinds of life, so 'we have ALL' (all of us) is lost. The proposal keeps both 'all' and 'both … and', and 工作中 is more natural than 职业生活. It still fits the professional gloss (工作上的).

k39 s15: 让消费者承受……措辞 is an odd collocation, and 为什么……的理由 says the same thing twice. 用“…”来给消费者增添负担 is exactly what 'burden consumers with' means, and the quoted content still matches the English. Nothing new goes wrong.

k39 s3: 损害消费者的选择 is a stiff collocation. Here 'impair consumer choice' means harming consumers' freedom to choose, so 损害消费者的选择权 is the natural and precise wording, and the 'choice' gloss still lines up.

k39 s13: In 最近一次是在州一级, 一次 has nothing to refer back to, so it reads as a literal rendering. 最近的举措出现在州一级 says the same thing ('most recently, at the state level') clearly and leads naturally into the California regulations in s14.

k39 summary: The list names 各种手法 (techniques) but the example given is a 服务 (service), so the categories don't match. Rewriting the example as the technique itself (让…注册顺畅、取消却很难) fixes the logic without changing the meaning.
k40 s9: Putting 包括…… after 并无差别 makes the list seem to describe the differences, and it is English word order. 在包括……在内的一系列行为上 is standard Chinese, and the meaning and every item are kept.

k40 s6: As it stands, 另一半学生把重点放在了慈善捐赠上 can be read as the students themselves turning to charity. In fact the control group's lesson was about charitable giving. 学习重点 removes that misreading and keeps the 'focus on' wording.
k40 summary: 另一组学生仍为52% is missing its subject, since students cannot 'be 52%'. 这一比例 fixes it and matches s11.
k40 s6: 而 is a connective, not a meaning of instead. 转而；作为替代 gives the actual adverbial sense here (doing the other thing as the alternative). POS is correct.

k40 s6: Here 'the other half' is a free combination with its literal meaning. The real idiom means 'spouse' or 'the other social class', so labelling it a phrase misleads. Both words are basic, and 'half' in s5 is not glossed either. The sentence still has focus on, charitable giving and instead, so it is not left empty.
k40 s2: 'a single ethics lesson' means just one lesson. In Chinese, 单一的 suggests 'uniform or not varied' (单一的经济结构), which is the wrong sense. 仅仅一个的；单个的 is precise.

k39 s13: Around meaning 'concerning or surrounding (an issue)' is a high-frequency sense in journalism (controversy/concerns around…), and many learners don't know it. It is currently unglossed. 'around' occurs only once in the sentence, and prep. 围绕；关于 matches the ZH 暗黑模式问题上的.

Contrastive 'while' is a key signal word that 考研 learners must master, and it has no entry here. The ZH already renders it as 而, and conj. 而；然而（表示对比） is correct for this sentence.

The question in [5] is the user-pays argument itself. In Chinese, 按照这种说法 can read as drawing an absurd consequence from it, which is misleading. 持这种观点的人会问：凭什么要让……去补贴…… keeps 'should … have to' and the indignant tone, and is more natural. The gloss for 'the argument goes' should then become 持这种观点的人认为；按这种观点的说法.
印尼 is the standard, unambiguous short form of 印度尼西亚, and titles routinely abbreviate. The title is not imprecise or misleading, and the change is not clearly more natural.
Nothing earlier in the summary introduces a sum of money, so 这笔钱 has no antecedent. 领到的现金 is precise and matches 'cash transfers'.

个人可以转而…… is stiff translationese. 人们就可以改用这笔钱 keeps 'instead' (改用, in contrast to clearing land in [19]) and continues the reference to 人们 from [19]. The meaning is exact. Optionally add 人 to the individual gloss: n. 个人；人.

vb.why: k42[22]: The diagnosis is right. In Chinese, 市场准入 means regulatory permission to enter a market, but here the phrase is about rural households' practical access to markets. The proposed 进入市场的条件 is still ambiguous, because 条件 can be read as entry requirements, which brings back the 准入 sense. 进入市场的便利程度 is precise and unambiguous.

vb.why: k42[22]: Same reason as index 0. Match the gloss to the amended ZH and avoid 条件, which can be read as regulatory requirements. 市场可及性 is the usual term in development economics.

k41[10]: 遭受的干扰 is translationese, and 干扰 is the wrong sense. In this sentence, disruption means trains cancelled or not running. 出行受阻 is precise and idiomatic, and 受阻 still matches the highlighted word disruption.

vb.amended_proposed: 2007年，印度尼西亚开始逐步推行一个项目，在一定条件下向最贫困的居民发放钱款，比如要求人们不让孩子辍学，或定期接受医疗服务。

But 继续上学、不辍学 says the same thing twice, and no editor would keep both. 不让孩子辍学 says it once and precisely. The glosses should change to match: keep…in school → 让……继续上学；不让……辍学; medical care → 医疗服务；医疗保健.

vb.amended_proposed: 同样，人们也觉得，与那些不得不忍受中部和北部地区基础设施相对落后的人相比，东南部的通勤者（其中许多人将面临数一数二的涨幅）所经历的艰辛受到了过多关注。

k41[1]: The current ZH uses the clunky nominalisation 为……的又一次上涨找到正当理由. The proposal is idiomatic and keeps the rhetorical force (possibly = 究竟), plus justify = 正当理由, yet another = 又一次 and increase = 上调.

k42[15]: This is a genuine grammatical flaw, a mixed construction in which the subject 热带森林面积 is said to be 国家之一. The proposal gives both clauses the same subject, 印度尼西亚, and keeps every highlighted word.

vb.amended_proposed: 费拉罗说，在那里，随着人们手头的钱多了起来，其中一些人可能开辟了更多土地来饲养肉牛。

k42[11]: 研究……为研究对象 repeats 研究 needlessly, and an editor would cut it. The change does not alter the meaning, and no highlighted word is affected.
k42[24]: The quoted words are part of the narrator's sentence, not an independent quotation after 说：, so under GB/T 15834 the full stop goes outside the closing quotation mark.
k41[13]: In cramped, unreliable services, services means train services in British usage, not 服务 in the abstract. The proposed gloss gives the exact sense and matches the corrected ZH (列车拥挤、服务不可靠).

k41[2]: In grimly reliable annual ritual, reliable means sure to recur. 可靠的 points to the wrong sense, and 从不落空的 suggests something hoped for. The new gloss gives the exact sense and fits the ZH 雷打不动.
k42[6]: The sentence is only about children's physical growth. The economic sense 增长 does not apply here (it belongs to [9]), so 生长；发育 is the exact gloss.
k42[9]: Contrastive while is a core 考研 signal word and is missing from the list. Dictionaries give 而；然而, and the ZH already renders it as 而.

k41[5]: 按照这种说法，…为什么得… can be read as the author drawing an absurd consequence. The rhetorical why should is actually the argument made by supporters of making users pay. 持这种观点的人会问：凭什么要让…去… renders the argument goes and should…have to precisely and idiomatically.
k42 title: 印尼 is the standard, universally understood short form, and it is normal in Chinese titles. The current title is accurate and natural, and the change is only a matter of taste.
k42 summary: 这笔钱 has nothing to refer back to, because no sum of money has been mentioned before, only the name of the programme. 领到的现金 fixes this without changing the meaning.

k42[20]: 个人 as the subject here is stiff and bureaucratic. 人们 continues the 人们 of [19], and 改用 renders instead precisely as using the money in place of clearing land. The gloss individual = n. 个人 is still correct as a gloss.
