va.amended_proposed: 按党派划线的投票（投票者完全按所属党派立场投票）
va.why: The gloss should match the new translation. But here the voters are FCC commissioners, not legislators, so “议员” is wrong for this sentence. Use the neutral 投票者.
“较量和摇摆……都亟须国会采取行动” is an awkward subject–predicate match, and the “都” is odd. “面对……，国会亟须采取行动” keeps cry out for (亟须) and act (采取行动) and conveys the same demand for action. It is clearly more natural.
“一直几乎” stacks two adverbs awkwardly. “部分原因在于……的抵制” is cleaner than the subjectless “部分原因是遭到了”. “至今” keeps the present-perfect sense and “几乎” keeps the degree.
With the same subject, the pronoun 它 is redundant. “却没有……，只是……” keeps instead of / only and reads naturally, with nothing lost.

“shatter the image of” is a free combination, not a set phrase, so the key word shatter loses its POS. Make the entry shatter = v. 打破；粉碎（形象、观念等）. As suggested, the second image (形象 sense) should be covered by extending the image entry to n. 图像；形象 so both occurrences are glossed.
The dictionary form is “cause a stir” (引起轰动); quite is only an intensifier. A gloss of 引起（不小的）轰动 fits the sentence. The highlight can stay, or become “causing … a stir”.
Here resolution means settling the dispute. 决议 (a formal motion) is an irrelevant sense and, next to “court”, could mislead.

The sentence uses the full correlative “not only eliminated … but rejected”. The headword not only…but (also) with gloss 不仅……而且…… and highlight “not only … but” marks the whole structure. “but” occurs only once in the sentence.
The structure to learn is “not … either” (也不); “cannot…either” is not a dictionary form. A gloss of 也不 (used in negatives) fits, and the highlight “couldn’t … either” stays.

va.amended_proposed: avoid=v. 避免（后接动名词：avoid doing 避免做某事）
va.why: The gap is real: avoid is unannotated, while words of the same level (provide, require, protect, create) are. But a phrase headword “avoid doing” would have to highlight “avoid trapping”, which collides with the existing “trapping … in” highlight. Make it a single-word entry highlighting "avoid", with the avoid + -ing pattern in the gloss.
In this sentence human means relatable, like ordinary people with feelings, not kind or humane. 有人性的 and 有人情味的 point the wrong way. The new gloss is precise, and #6 is amended to 更有血有肉 to match.

The current text matches the file. Per s12–s13, further battles follow because states may pass laws while the FCC keeps the power to preempt individual ones (e.g. DOJ vs California). Without that half, “因此” has no basis. The addition is accurate.

vb.why: k43 s15: “there could be nothing more damning” is emphatic: nothing could be worse. “恐怕” adds a hedge the English doesn't have and weakens Twain's judgement.
k43 s8: “不置可否” means withholding an opinion, which is the wrong sense for a facial expression. “相机履行神奇职责” is a stiff calque. The proposed sentence is natural and keeps every element of the English.
k43 s8: here non-committal describes a stare that reveals no feeling. The gloss must lead with that sense.
k43 s5: “stare into the middle distance” means gazing vacantly, not at a nearby spot. “前方不远处” is a literal mistranslation. The proposal is natural and accurate.
k43 s6: “trend” refers to the prevailing pattern of unsmiling sitters. Chinese “趋势” implies change over time, which is misleading here. “这种现象” is precise and idiomatic.
k43 s9: in Chinese, “很” before a predicate adjective is the unmarked form and does not really add degree. “还是很慢” is accurate and natural, so the change is only a matter of taste.

vb.amended_proposed: 他们注意到，笑是我们与维多利亚时代的人共有的体验，隔开双方的一百来年时光由此渐渐淡去，那个时代的人似乎一下子变得更加有血有肉了。
vb.why: k43 s4: the restructuring is right because the current sentence is heavy translationese. But “more human” here means relatable, like real people (see #21), not “有人情味” (warm or kind). The ZH should use the corrected sense so it matches the gloss.
k43 s12: “暗指的事实是，……” is a stiff nominalised calque. “暗指这样一个事实：……” is natural, keeps the same meaning, and still matches the allude to / the fact that entries.
k43 s3: “惊讶地看到了证据：” copies the English structure. “惊讶地发现，有证据表明……” is idiomatic and keeps the meaning.

vb.amended_proposed: 正因如此，人们才一直这么强烈地要求出台规则，阻止宽带服务商在网上决定谁胜谁负，从而维护向来是互联网命脉的自由与创新。
vb.why: k44 s2: fixing the doubled “如此” is a real improvement. Turning the short modifier into “——它们向来是……” adds translationese (“它们”) and is not needed, because “向来是互联网命脉的自由与创新” reads naturally.
k44 s5: “党派路线投票” is an opaque calque. “按党派划线的投票” is the clearer, established Chinese expression.

vb.amended_proposed: 按党派划线的投票（各成员完全按所属党派立场投票）
vb.why: k44 s5: the gloss should match the revised ZH. But this vote was cast by FCC commissioners, not legislators, so “议员” is wrong in this sentence. Use “成员”.

k44 s14: “较量和摇摆都亟须国会采取行动” is awkward, and “都” makes it sound as if each one separately needs Congress. “面对……，国会亟须采取行动” is natural and keeps the meaning that the situation urgently calls for Congress to act.
k44 s3: “一直几乎” stacks two adverbs awkwardly, and “部分原因是遭到了” is clumsy. The proposal is smoother. “至今” keeps the present perfect and “几乎” keeps “almost”.
k44 s4: the extra “它” and the “但……而只是” linkage are translationese. “却没有……，只是……” is concise and keeps the meaning of “instead of … only prolonged”.

vb.amended_proposed: Replace the phrase entry with: shatter (单词) v. 打破；粉碎（形象、观念等） ← "shatter". Then add, directly after it: image (单词) n. 形象 ← "image" (the second occurrence, in “the image of 19th-century prudery”). The existing image entry keeps its 图像 sense for the first occurrence.
vb.why: k43 s1: “shatter the image of” is a free combination, and shatter is a word learners must memise with its POS. But removing the phrase would leave the 形象 sense of the second “image” unannotated, so it needs its own entry.

vb.amended_proposed: cause a stir (短语) 引起轰动 ← "causing quite a stir"
vb.why: k43 s2: the dictionary form is “cause a stir”, and “quite” is only an intensifier. Fix the gloss as 引起轰动 so it matches the headword. “不小的” comes from quite and stays in the ZH translation.
k44 s4: resolution here means the settling of the dispute. “决议” is a different sense and could be misread as a court resolution.
k44 s6: the sentence uses the full correlative “not only … but”. Annotating only “not only” leaves the structure half marked. Gloss: 不仅……而且…….
k44 s7: the learnable pattern is “not … either” (也不). “cannot…either” is not a dictionary form. The highlight stays “couldn’t … either”.

vb.amended_proposed: Add: avoid (单词) v. 避免（后接动名词：avoid doing 避免做某事） ← "avoid"
vb.why: k44 s11: avoid is a core word and is missing. But a phrase highlight “avoid trapping” would overlap the existing “trapping … in” highlight. Annotate the single word and give the avoid doing pattern in the gloss.
k43 s4: “more human” here means relatable, like ordinary people with feelings, not humane or warm. “有血有肉的；像常人一样（有喜怒哀乐）的” gives the exact sense. The ZH is aligned to match in #6.

vb.amended_proposed: 但驳回了委员会阻止所有州级网络中立规则的企图，同时保留了委员会的权力，使其仍可推翻有损其命令的个别州法律，争斗因此延续下去。
vb.why: k44 summary: the addition is needed, because the fights continue only because both rulings stand together (s12–s13). The proposed wording piles up “的” (“推翻个别有损其命令的州法律的权力”). This rewording mirrors s12's ZH and reads more smoothly.

k45 summary: the '瑞典北欧航空公司' error is real, but #9 fixes it over the larger span that contains this one and also fixes the run-on sentence. Applying this one as well would make the edits conflict.
k45 S11: '可以说' (arguably) + '往好里讲也只能算' (at best = a ceiling) is precise, and it gets rid of the repeated 说. All other clauses are unchanged.

k45 S8: 被举为 reads as 推举为. 常被奉为标杆 is the idiomatic way to say 'held up / given as the gold standard', and the colon clause still says what AT&T did. 而没有采用 correctly renders 'rather than go with' for a past decision.
k45 S14: 'those rates' = the US and Canada rates from S13. 两国失业率已分别 is precise and natural, and 分别 keeps the pairing; 这两个失业率 is clunky.
k45 S15: 'meant that there were' is causal (the pandemic is why the shortages remained). 使得……依然短缺 states the cause clearly; 疫情意味着 is a literal calque.
k46 S10: 'farm more intensively' covers livestock as well as crops, and the dash explicitly mentions factory-style production. 耕作 narrows it to cultivating land, so 集约化地从事农业生产 is more accurate.
k46 S10: in this sentence farm (v.) means farming in general, not tilling. The new gloss matches the corrected ZH.

k45 summary: 'Scandinavian Airlines' is the joint Scandinavian carrier, and the EN only says 'That seems to be the case in Sweden'. 瑞典似乎就是如此 matches S18 exactly. Splitting the run-on with a full stop also removes the clause-as-subject structure. Supersedes #2 and #24.
k45 summary: 可以说 = arguably and 充其量只是 = at best, which is precise and removes the doubled 说.

va.amended_proposed: 技能错配一旦出现在整体经济中，人们通常就会把目光转向政府、指望政府来应对
va.why: k45 summary: '人们通常转向政府' is incomplete and ambiguous, so the 目光/应对 fix is right. The amendment also includes #26's change ('the broader economy' = 整体经济, consistent with S10 #25), because the two spans overlap.
k45 summary: 总想 renders 'the temptation is always to' naturally and removes the long stacked 的-attribute before 诱惑. Nothing else in the clause changes.
k46 S7: '报告显示' = 'according to a report', and 该国 = 'the country's'. Nothing is added or lost, and dropping the third 英国 and the long 根据……的 frame makes it clearly more natural.
k46 S9: 虽然……但依然很严峻 keeps both 'many caveats' and 'still grave' and replaces the nominalised 之处 construction, so it reads more naturally.
k45 S11: 按理说 means 'it ought to be so (but may not be)', which is not arguably. 有理由认为 is the correct second sense.
k45 S13: 'generational lows' = the lowest in a generation. 代际的 means between generations, which is misleading here.

va.amended_proposed: headword: as；gloss: conj. 正如……一样（后接倒装：as will + 主语 ＝……也会如此）；高亮原文: "as"
va.why: k45 S2: 'as will' is not a phrase. It is 'as' followed by subject–auxiliary inversion, so a single-word entry with POS is the correct form. The proposal only changed the headword and would have left a single word with no POS, so the full entry is spelled out here.

va.amended_proposed: ~give…as=把……列为；把……当作（例子、典范）
va.why: k45 S8: 'is often given as' (= cited/held up as) is a sense learners can miss, so it should be annotated. 举作 is not a standard word, so the gloss uses 列为/当作, which also matches the 奉为 in the revised ZH. Highlight 'given as'.

va.amended_proposed: headword: move；gloss: n. 转变；举措（a move back to … 回归……）；高亮原文: "move"
va.why: k46 S5: 'A move back to' has move as a noun. Labelling it as the phrase 'move back to' suggests the verb phrase (搬回), which is misleading. The full entry is spelled out so the result is a single word with POS.

va.amended_proposed: v. 满足（需求）
va.why: k46 S8: 足够支付 is the cover-costs sense and does not apply here. The proposed 够……所需 is awkward, and 满足（需求） alone gives the exact sense used.

k46 S12: 'grow crops 种植农作物' is a correctly glossed, high-frequency verb–object collocation, so it is not wrong or misleading. Replacing it with crop alone would leave grow (种植) unannotated in this sentence.
k46 title: 粮食 in Chinese usually means grain, but the passage covers meat, dairy, fruit and vegetables. 食物自给自足 matches the body's usage (S3–S5, S10).
k46 S14: 'the suitable land' refers back to S13's land suitable for crop-growing. 适合的土地 is incomplete in Chinese, and 适合种植的土地 is precise.
k45 summary: the error is real, but #9 makes the same fix over the larger span and handles the sentence break more cleanly. Applying both would make the edits conflict.
k45 S10: 'the broader economy' is the economy as a whole, as opposed to the individual companies in S6. 更广泛的经济领域 suggests sectors or fields, while 整体经济 is precise.
k45 summary: the fix is valid but has been merged into #11's amendment, since the two spans overlap. The proposed '中时' is also clunky.

vb.amended_proposed: 这部分生产供应了国内肉类和奶制品消费量的80%，因此，即使让畜牧场遍布全国，也无法满足我们对肉类和奶制品的全部需求。
vb.why: The problem is real. The 'so … all our meat and dairy needs' logic only works if this means 80% of meat and dairy consumed, and the current wording reads as 80% of all food, which contradicts the 60% in S4. I kept 供应 so it matches the supply gloss (v. 供应；提供) and avoids using 满足 twice in one sentence.

vb.amended_proposed: 这部分生产供应了国内肉类和奶制品消费量的80%
vb.why: Same real error as #0. The wording matches the amended S8 and keeps 供应.

The error it targets (瑞典北欧航空公司) is real, but #24 fixes the same span better. #2 keeps the run-on and still hangs 似乎 on SAS's action. Its current string overlaps #24's, so applying both would clash. #24 is the one to apply.

vb.amended_proposed: 加拿大和其他地方的努力，可以说充其量只是有气无力，还让我们陷入了这样一种局面：经常听说雇主苦求人手，即便在失业率高的时期和地区也是如此。
vb.why: The current 往好里说也可以说是 repeats 说 and loses the ceiling sense of 'at best'. The proposed 可以说往好里讲 is still clunky. 可以说 (arguably) plus 充其量 (at best, matching the 至多 gloss) is precise and idiomatic, and matches #10's summary wording.
被举为 suggests 推举为 and is unidiomatic. 常被奉为标杆 is the natural rendering of 'often given as the gold standard', and the meaning is kept.
这两个失业率 is translationese. 两国失业率已分别 is natural and keeps the US/Canada pairing from S13.
Here 'meant that' is causal. 疫情使得…依然明显短缺 is clearer and more idiomatic than the literal 意味着, and it is covered by the gloss mean v. 意味着；导致.

vb.amended_proposed: 要大大提高自给程度，英国就需要大幅减少动物性食物的消费，而且可能还要更加集约化地经营农业——这意味着绿色田野会减少，工厂化生产会增加。
vb.why: The problem is real: 耕作 means tilling and leaves out the livestock behind 'factory-style production'. 集约化地经营农业 covers all farming and avoids the 农业生产…工厂化生产 repetition in the proposal.
耕作 is too narrow for 'farm more intensively'. 从事农业生产；务农 gives the right sense with the correct POS.

It is a valid fix for the same 瑞典北欧航空公司 error, but it duplicates #24 and its current string contains #24's, so applying both would clash. #24 is applied instead; it is equivalent and mirrors the S18 wording.
往好里说也可以说是 is clumsy. 可以说充其量只是有气无力 is precise for 'arguably … at best' and matches the amended S11.

vb.amended_proposed: 技能错配出现在整个经济层面时，人们通常把目光转向政府、指望政府来应对
vb.why: 人们通常转向政府 is incomplete and ambiguous, so the fix is right. I merged in the 'broader economy' correction from #25/#26, because #26's current string is a substring of this one. Apply this single edit and not #26 separately.
总有……的诱惑 hangs a long two-level 的 attributive on 诱惑, which is translationese. 总想 conveys the temptation naturally and loses no meaning.

vb.amended_proposed: 据英国利兹大学一份关于英国食物生产的报告，该国国土总面积的85%与肉类和奶制品生产相关。
vb.why: Using 英国 three times plus the 根据…的报告 frame is redundant, so the trim is right. 据…报告 does this while keeping the according-to structure that matches the gloss (根据) and the summary (据利兹大学的报告).
有许多需要附加说明之处 is nominalised translationese. 虽然需要附加许多说明，但依然很严峻 is fluent and keeps both the caveat and the grave meaning.
按理说 means 'logically it should be (but isn't)', which is not arguably. 有理由认为 is the correct second sense.
代际的 means intergenerational and is the wrong sense here. In 'generational lows' the word means 一代人（以来）的.

vb.amended_proposed: as（单词）conj. ……也一样（后接倒装：as will … ＝……也会如此）；高亮原文 as
vb.why: 'as will' is not a lexical phrase. It is the conjunction as followed by inversion, so it should be a single-word entry with a POS. 正如 does not fit this use well ('X will change, as will Y' = Y will too), so the gloss leads with ……也一样 and keeps the inversion note.

vb.amended_proposed: ~give…as=把……作为（例子、典范）提出；举……为例
vb.why: 'is often given as' uses an uncommon sense of give (cite as) that learners may misread, so it should be annotated (highlight 'given as'). 举作 in the proposal is not standard Chinese.

vb.amended_proposed: move（单词）n. 转变；转向（a move back to … 回归……）；高亮原文 move
vb.why: 'A move back to' is a noun, and the phrase entry with verbal 回到；回归 suggests the phrasal verb move back (搬回). The gloss should be noun. 举措 is a different sense (an action taken), so I dropped it.

vb.amended_proposed: v. 满足（需求）
vb.why: 足够支付 is the cover-costs sense and does not apply here, so it should go. The proposed 够……所需 is awkward Chinese, so the gloss should give only the sense used.

grow crops is a legitimate collocation entry, consistent with the passage's other collocations (livestock farm, animal food, close the gap). It is accurate and already teaches crop, so the change is taste.
粮食 strictly means grain or staples, but the passage is about meat, dairy, fruit and veg, and the body uses 食物/自给自足 throughout. 食物自给自足 is more precise and consistent. 粮食安全 in S1 stays.
适合的土地 is incomplete in Chinese (适合 needs an object). 适合种植的土地 makes the back-reference to S13 explicit without adding meaning.

瑞典北欧航空公司 wrongly makes SAS a Swedish company. Putting 瑞典似乎就是这样的例子 before the colon matches 'That seems to be the case in Sweden' and the S18 ZH. This is the one fix to apply for this span (not #2 or #9).

vb.amended_proposed: 不过，技能错配一旦出现在整个经济层面，人们关注的焦点通常就会转向政府，由政府来应对。
vb.why: 'The broader economy' means the economy as a whole, in contrast to individual companies, so 领域 wrongly adds a sector sense. 整个经济层面 states that contrast more naturally than 整体经济中.
The change is valid but has been merged into #11's amendment, because its current string overlaps #11's. Applying it separately would break #11's match.

findings.current: 尽管现阶段这只是一个研究项目，但这一要求已让人想到一种可能：监管机构会介入早期科技市场，而这些市场迄今为止一直在它们的管辖范围之外。
findings.proposed: 尽管现阶段这只是一个研究项目，但这一要求已让人想到一种可能：监管机构会介入早期科技市场，而这些市场迄今为止一直是它们鞭长莫及的地方。
findings.reason: “beyond their reach”的意思是监管一直够不着、没能触及，不是“在管辖范围之外”（不是说没有法定管辖权）。原文说的是这类小交易一直逃过了审查，不是说监管机构无权管，“管辖范围”改变了原意。

findings.current: 但要是你开启自动驾驶模式，就没问题。
findings.proposed: 但要是你进入“自动驾驶”状态，就没问题。
findings.reason: “go on automatic pilot”是比喻：不假思索、凭下意识去做。上一句讲的是开手动挡的车，这里写“开启自动驾驶模式”，读者会理解成真的打开汽车的自动驾驶功能（手动挡车并没有这个功能），容易误解。加引号、改用“状态”，读者就知道是比喻。

findings.current: 然而，批评者说，大公司利用这类交易，趁最具威胁的潜在竞争对手的业务还没有机会获得发展势头，就把它们买下来；有时这是“收购再扼杀”策略的一部分，目的就是干脆把它们关掉。
findings.proposed: 然而，批评者说，大公司利用这类交易，趁最具威胁的潜在竞争对手的业务还没来得及发展壮大，就把它们买下来；有时这是“收购再扼杀”策略的一部分，目的就是干脆把它们关掉。
findings.reason: “还没有机会获得发展势头”是照搬“have a chance to gain momentum”的翻译腔，不地道；“还没来得及发展壮大”意思不变，读起来自然（概要里写的也是“尚未壮大”）。

findings.current: 微软自家的Office主导着“生产力”软件市场，而这两家初创公司代表的是专为智能手机世界从零设计的新一波技术。
findings.proposed: 微软自家的Office主导着“生产力”软件市场，而这两家初创公司代表的是专为智能手机时代从零打造的新一波技术。
findings.reason: “智能手机世界”是照搬“the smartphone world”的翻译腔；中文习惯说“智能手机时代”。“从零打造”比“从零设计”更符合中文搭配。

findings.current: 正如预期，依靠直觉拖累了他们在前四项任务上的表现，而在其余任务上帮助了他们。
findings.proposed: 正如预期，依靠直觉拖累了他们在前四项任务上的表现，却有助于他们完成其余任务。
findings.reason: “而在其余任务上帮助了他们”是逐字翻译：主语接不上，“在……任务上帮助了他们”这个搭配也生硬。改成“却有助于他们完成……”，主语不变，意思和语气都没变。

findings.current: 依靠直觉使参与者在调动反思性思维的任务上表现变差，却对调动直觉和创造力的任务有帮助
findings.proposed: 依靠直觉让参与者在调动反思性思维的任务上表现变差，却有助于他们完成调动直觉和创造力的任务
findings.reason: 前后两个分句结构不平行。“对……任务有帮助”搭配不当，帮的是参与者，不是任务。毛病和第20句一样。

findings.current: “他们买下幼苗，然后就把它们关掉了。”总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures公司合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道。他所指的这些交易，让一些有朝一日可能成长为竞争对手的企业就此终结。
findings.proposed: “他们买下幼苗，然后就把它们关掉了。”总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures公司合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道。他所指的这些交易，终结了一些有朝一日可能成长为竞争对手的企业。
findings.reason: “让……企业就此终结”是“企业终结”这种不通的主谓搭配，读起来别扭。改成“交易终结了……企业”，直接对应 put an end to businesses，高亮的“终结”保留。

findings.current: 在微软的批评者看来，Wunderlist和Sunrise的下场正是例证，表明科技巨头一心要无情地吞掉挡在自己道路上的任何创新公司。
findings.proposed: 在微软的批评者看来，Wunderlist和Sunrise的下场正是例证，说明科技巨头一心要无情地吞掉挡在自己路上的任何创新公司。
findings.reason: “挡在自己道路上”是直译，中文一般说“挡在自己路上”，或者加上“前进”说“挡在前进道路上”。“例证，表明”换成“例证，说明”，衔接更顺，意思不变。

findings.current: 两家公司的工程师团队则留了下来，这样一来，这两笔收购就成了众多“人才收购”中的两例，而最大的那些公司一直靠这类收购来满足自己对科技人才的强烈渴求。
findings.proposed: 两家公司的工程师团队则留了下来，这样一来，这两笔收购就成了众多“人才收购”中的两例，而最大的几家公司一直靠这类收购来满足自己对科技人才的强烈渴求。
findings.reason: “最大的那些公司”是 the biggest companies 的翻译腔。中文习惯说“最大的几家公司”，上下文讲的正是那几家科技巨头。

findings.current: 过去五年间，最大的五家科技公司在低于10亿美元的收购上合计平均每年只花了34亿美元——与它们巨额的资金储备相比，与去年投入美国的1300多亿美元风险资本相比，这都不过是沧海一粟。
findings.proposed: 过去五年间，最大的五家科技公司在金额低于10亿美元的收购上合计平均每年只花了34亿美元——与它们庞大的资金储备相比，与去年在美国投入的1300多亿美元风险资本相比，这都不过是沧海一粟。
findings.reason: “低于10亿美元的收购”省掉了中心语，应说“金额低于10亿美元的收购”；“投入美国的风险资本”搭配别扭，应说“在美国投入的”；“巨额的资金储备”不如“庞大的资金储备”自然。意思不变。

findings.current: 在一项研究中，参与者完成了一组共八项任务，其中四项调动的是反思性思维（辨别规则、理解词汇），另外四项调动的是直觉和创造力（想出新产品或修辞说法）。
findings.proposed: 在一项研究中，参与者完成了一组共八项任务，其中四项调动的是反思性思维（辨别规则、理解词汇），另外四项调动的是直觉和创造力（想出新产品或修辞表达）。
findings.reason: “修辞说法”不是规范的中文术语。generating figures of speech 指造出比喻之类的修辞，说“修辞表达”才自然。

findings.current: 修辞说法；修辞手法
findings.proposed: 修辞手法；修辞表达（如比喻）
findings.reason: “修辞说法”不是中文常用搭配，标准说法是“修辞手法”；本句指造出的具体修辞，用“修辞表达”与改后的译文一致。

findings.current: 其他研究表明，我们依靠直觉而非反思时，更善于凭经验薄片识破欺骗行为。
findings.proposed: 其他研究表明，我们依靠直觉而非反思时，更善于凭经验“薄片”识破欺骗行为。
findings.reason: “凭经验薄片”是生造的复合词，不加标记读者很难看懂。加引号表明这是第1、2句提出的“薄片”概念，意思不变。

findings.current: 有时干脆直接关停
findings.proposed: 有时干脆将其关停
findings.reason: “干脆”和“直接”意思重复，叠用显得啰嗦，原文 simply 只对应一个词。

findings.current: 后来弃用了这两款应用
findings.proposed: 后来弃用了这两家公司的应用
findings.reason: 前文只提到“两家……初创公司”，没说是应用，突然出现“这两款应用”指代不清，读者对不上号。

findings.current: adv. 就个人而言；亲自
findings.proposed: adv. 对本人而言；就个人而言
findings.reason: In “personally satisfying” the word means the buyers themselves found the decision satisfying (译文：让自己更满意). The second sense, 亲自 (“in person”), is a different meaning that does not fit this sentence and could mislead learners.

findings.proposed: business=n. 企业；公司
findings.reason: In “put an end to businesses that might one day turn into competitors”, business is a countable noun meaning 企业. Many learners only know the 生意 sense. The word comes up again in [8] and [16] but has no entry anywhere in the passage.

findings.current: n. 一瞥；瞥见
findings.proposed: n. 一瞥；匆匆一看
findings.reason: The entry is labelled n., but 瞥见 is a verb meaning. Here the word is a noun (“a glimpse of a photo”).

findings.current: n. 人才；天赋
findings.proposed: n. 人才；（总称）有才能的人
findings.reason: In “hunger for tech talent” the word means talented people collectively (人才). 天赋 (“natural ability”) is a different sense and does not fit this sentence.

findings.proposed: ~spend…on=在……上花（钱）
findings.reason: “have spent an average of only $3.4 billion a year on sub-$1 billion acquisitions” uses the split pattern spend…on, and the passage has no entry for it. Learners need to recognise it across the long gap between the two words.

findings.current: 关键在于，另一组参与者按要求先花一分钟写下自己作出判断的理由，然后再评分。
findings.proposed: 关键在于，还有一组参与者按要求先花一分钟写下自己作出判断的理由，然后再评分。
findings.reason: Sentence 4 already says '另一组参与者' for the backward-counting group. Repeating '另一组' here can be read as the same group, but this is a third group. '还有一组' makes the reference clear.

findings.current: 参与者先写下判断理由再评分，准确度大幅下降
findings.proposed: 被要求先写下判断理由再评分的那组参与者，评分准确度大幅下降
findings.reason: As written, the summary implies that all of Ambady's participants did this and lost accuracy. In the passage, only one group (sentence 6) wrote down reasons, and the first two groups rated accurately.

va.why: k47 s13: the problem is real. 'beyond their reach' means regulators have not managed to reach these markets in practice, and 管辖范围之外 wrongly says they have no legal jurisdiction. 鞭长莫及 is the right fix, but calling a market a 地方 is awkward, so 领域 is used instead.
va.amended_proposed: 尽管现阶段这只是一个研究项目，但这一要求已让人想到一种可能：监管机构会介入早期科技市场，而这些市场迄今为止一直是它们鞭长莫及的领域。

va.why: k48 s12: right after the stick-shift sentence, 开启自动驾驶模式 reads like a real car feature. Putting the term in quotes and using 状态 marks it as a metaphor for acting without conscious thought, and the meaning is kept.
k47 s16: 还没来得及 covers 'have a chance to', and 发展壮大 is a natural rendering of 'gain momentum' that also matches the summary's 尚未壮大. It is more natural and no less precise.
k47 s2: 智能手机时代 is more idiomatic than 智能手机世界. But 打造 drifts from 'designed', the highlighted word glossed as 设计, so keep 从零设计.
va.amended_proposed: 微软自家的Office主导着“生产力”软件市场，而这两家初创公司代表的是专为智能手机时代从零设计的新一波技术。

va.why: k48 s20: the current wording is indeed stiff. But 有助于他们完成其余任务 shifts the meaning to finishing the tasks, while the EN 'helped them on the rest' means it helped their performance. Keep the parallel with 表现.
va.amended_proposed: 正如预期，依靠直觉拖累了他们在前四项任务上的表现，却让他们在其余任务上表现得更好。

va.why: k48 summary: 对……任务有帮助 is a real collocation problem. Use the same fix as s20 and keep the performance sense rather than 完成.
va.amended_proposed: 依靠直觉使参与者在调动反思性思维的任务上表现变差，在调动直觉和创造力的任务上却表现更好

va.why: k47 s6: 企业就此终结 is awkward, but 终结了……企业 is an equally odd collocation. 就此夭折 is idiomatic, accurately conveys 'put an end to' young businesses, and carries on the seedlings image.
va.amended_proposed: “他们买下幼苗，然后就把它们关掉了。”总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures公司合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道。他所指的这些交易，让一些有朝一日可能成长为竞争对手的企业就此夭折。

va.why: k47 s5: 挡在自己路上 is the natural colloquial form and 说明 reads smoothly. Every clause stays as precise as before.
k47 s4: 最大的几家公司 is more natural than 最大的那些公司 and correctly refers to the Big Tech firms. The superlative is kept.
k47 s15: 金额低于10亿美元的收购 restores the missing head noun, and 在美国投入的 accurately renders 'invested in the US'. 庞大 is fine. Every clause is checked and the sense is unchanged.
k48 s18: 修辞说法 is not a standard term. 修辞表达 is acceptable for the concrete figures of speech the participants produced, and it is no less precise.
k48 s18: dropping 修辞说法 is right. But the sense used in this sentence (the concrete expressions produced) should come first, so the order is swapped.
va.amended_proposed: 修辞表达（如比喻）；修辞手法

va.why: k48 s10: 凭经验薄片 reads like a coined compound. Putting 薄片 in quotes links it to the concept from s1–2 without changing the meaning.
k47 summary: 干脆 and 直接 are redundant, and 'simply' corresponds to only one of them. 将其关停 is correct.
k47 summary: no apps have been mentioned before 这两款应用, so the reference is unclear. 这两家公司的应用 is accurate.
k48 s16: 'personally satisfying' means satisfying to the buyers themselves. The 亲自 ('in person') sense is wrong here, and the proposed senses are correct.
k47 s6: 'businesses' is a countable noun here meaning companies, an important sense beyond 生意 that 考研 learners must know. It has no entry anywhere in the passage, and n. 企业；公司 is correct.
k48 s1: the entry is marked as a noun ('a glimpse of a photo'), but 瞥见 is a verb meaning. 一瞥；匆匆一看 is correct.
k47 s4: 'tech talent' means talented people as a group. 天赋 is a different sense that does not fit this sentence. The proposed gloss is correct.

k47 s15: spend is not glossed here even though 'spent … on' are split far apart. The project glosses spend elsewhere (k48 s6), 'on' occurs only once in the sentence, and the sense 在……上花（钱） is correct.
k48 s6: this is a third group. Repeating 另一组 from s4 is ambiguous, and 还有一组 renders the second 'another' precisely.
k48 summary: the current text implies that all participants wrote down reasons and lost accuracy. In fact only one group did (s6), and the other groups were accurate. The proposal is accurate.

vb.amended_proposed: 尽管现阶段这只是一个研究项目，但这一要求已让人想到一种可能：监管机构会介入早期科技市场，而迄今为止，它们对这些市场一直鞭长莫及。
vb.why: The proposer is right that 管辖范围之外 means they have no legal authority, which is not what the English says (the deals simply escaped scrutiny), and 鞭长莫及 is the right idiom. But calling a market 鞭长莫及的地方 is a clumsy collocation, so restructure the clause around the idiom instead.
The previous sentence is about driving a manual car, so 开启自动驾驶模式 reads as a literal car feature. The quotes plus 状态 mark it as a metaphor and keep the image.
还没有机会获得发展势头 is translationese. 还没来得及发展壮大 is accurate (来得及 covers 'have a chance') and idiomatic.
智能手机世界 is a calque, and 智能手机时代 is the natural Chinese for 'the smartphone world' here. 从零打造 renders 'designed from the ground up' idiomatically. The meaning is unchanged.

vb.amended_proposed: 正如预期，依靠直觉拖累了他们在前四项任务上的表现，却让他们在其余任务上表现更好。
vb.why: The current clause is awkward with no clear subject. But 有助于他们完成其余任务 is slightly off: the gut did not help them complete the tasks (everyone completed all eight), it helped how well they did on them. 让他们在其余任务上表现更好 is precise and parallel to the first clause.

vb.amended_proposed: 依靠直觉使参与者在调动反思性思维的任务上表现变差，在调动直觉和创造力的任务上则表现更好
vb.why: The fault is real: 对……任务有帮助 is the wrong collocation, since it helps the people, not the tasks. Use a parallel structure that matches the amended sentence 20 and avoids the 完成 inaccuracy.

vb.amended_proposed: “他们买下幼苗，然后就把它们关掉了。”总部位于旧金山的Switch Ventures公司合伙人保罗·阿诺德抱怨道。他所指的这些交易，让一些有朝一日可能成长为竞争对手的企业就此夭折。
vb.why: 企业就此终结 is indeed awkward, but 终结了……企业 is an equally odd collocation. 夭折 says precisely 'ended before they could grow into competitors' and fits the seedling metaphor.
挡在自己道路上 (no 的) is stiff. 挡在自己路上 is natural and keeps the meaning of 'lie in their path'. 表明→说明 is harmless.
最大的那些公司 is translationese, and 最大的几家公司 is natural and correctly refers to the Big Tech firms.
金额低于10亿美元的收购 supplies the missing head noun, and 在美国投入的 fixes the odd 投入美国的. 庞大的资金储备 reads better than 巨额的. Every figure and the meaning are unchanged.
修辞说法 is not a standard expression. 修辞表达 correctly renders the 'figures of speech' generated in the task.
修辞手法 is the standard equivalent, and 修辞表达（如比喻） gives the concrete sense used here and matches the revised translation.
凭经验薄片 looks like a made-up compound. Quoting “薄片” marks it as the term introduced in sentences 1–2, without changing the meaning.

vb.amended_proposed: 有时干脆关停
vb.why: Removing the redundant 直接 is right. But 将其 is already used in the preceding clause (就将其买下), so repeating it is clumsy; just delete 直接.
The summary has only mentioned two start-ups, so 这两款应用 has no antecedent. 这两家公司的应用 makes the reference clear.
亲自 ('in person') is a different sense that does not fit 'personally satisfying'. The new gloss gives only the sense used in this sentence.
Countable business = 企业 is a key 考研 sense that many learners do not know, and the word has no entry anywhere in the passage. Annotating it in sentence 6 is correct.
The entry is marked n., but 瞥见 is a verb meaning. 一瞥；匆匆一看 matches the noun in 'a glimpse of a photo'.
天赋 ('natural ability') is the wrong sense for 'tech talent'. The new gloss keeps 人才 and marks the collective sense.
spend…on across a long gap ('spent … on sub-$1 billion acquisitions') is a pattern learners must recognise, and spend is already glossed in k48. The gloss 在……上花（钱） is correct.
Sentence 4 already used 另一组 for the counting-backward group, so repeating it here blurs the reference. 还有一组 shows this is a third group.

vb.amended_proposed: 有一组参与者被要求先写下判断理由再评分，结果准确度大幅下降
vb.why: The current summary wrongly implies all participants did this; only one group did. The proposed wording is accurate but long and nominalised, and this version is just as precise and reads more naturally.
